+"""
+Li 2025 MDL-TL: pretrain on RepoRT (mode-specific, leave-target-out), fine-tune on 11 targets.
+
+Two pretrained models:
+  - RP model: pretrained on all RepoRT RP datasets excluding {0263,0264,0382,0383,0401,0420,0432,0435}
+  - HILIC model: pretrained on all RepoRT HILIC datasets excluding {0027,0183,0184}
+
+Usage:
+    python baselines/li2025/run.py -t report0184 --n_folds 5 -s 42 --device 0
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+import argparse
+import glob
+import time
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
+
+_BASELINES_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+sys.path.insert(0, _BASELINES_DIR)
+
+from common.data_utils import (
+    load_smiles_and_rt, canonicalize_and_dedup, kfold_split,
+    random_val_split, normalize_rt,
+)
+from common.evaluate import compute_metrics, save_fold_result, save_summary
+from common.fingerprint import (
+    compute_maccs, compute_mordred, clean_mordred_matrix
+)
+from li2025.cpv_encoder import CPVEncoder, load_metadata
+from li2025.model import MDLModel
+
+# ── Dataset definitions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+RP_TARGETS = {"report0180", "report0262", "report0263", "report0264",
+              "report0382", "report0401", "report0420"}
+HILIC_TARGETS = {"report0027", "report0183", "report0185"}
+ALL_TARGETS = RP_TARGETS | HILIC_TARGETS
+
+
+def get_mode(target):
+    if target in HILIC_TARGETS:
+        return "hilic"
+    return "rp"
+
+
+def get_report_id(dataset_name):
+    """Extract integer ID from 'reportXXXX' string."""
+    return int(dataset_name.replace("report", ""))
+
+
+# ── Feature computation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def compute_mol_features(smiles_list, mordred_clean_cols=None):
+    """
+    Compute MACCS + cleaned Mordred for a list of canonical SMILES.
+
+    If mordred_clean_cols is provided (from source training set), apply same column selection.
+    Otherwise, compute and clean from scratch.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    X_mf  : (N, 166) MACCS
+    X_md  : (N, D_md) cleaned Mordred
+    kept_cols : np.ndarray of column indices used for Mordred cleaning
+    """
+    n = len(smiles_list)
+
+    # MACCS
+    X_mf = np.stack([
+        (lambda v: v if v is not None else np.zeros(166, np.float32))(compute_maccs(s))
+        for s in smiles_list
+    ])
+
+    # Mordred
+    mordred_raw = []
+    for i, smi in enumerate(smiles_list):
+        if i % 1000 == 0 and n > 1000:
+            print(f"    [{i}/{n}]...", end="\r")
+        v = compute_mordred(smi)
+        if v is None:
+            v = np.full(1470, np.nan, np.float32)
+        mordred_raw.append(v)
+    X_raw = np.stack(mordred_raw)
+
+    if mordred_clean_cols is not None:
+        # Apply same column selection; impute NaN with column median
+        X_md = X_raw[:, mordred_clean_cols].astype(np.float64)
+        X_md[~np.isfinite(X_md)] = np.nan
+        col_med = np.nanmedian(X_md, axis=0)
+        for j in range(X_md.shape[1]):
+            mask = np.isnan(X_md[:, j])
+            if mask.any():
+                X_md[mask, j] = col_med[j]
+        X_md = X_md.astype(np.float32)
+        kept_cols = mordred_clean_cols
+    else:
+        X_md, kept_cols = clean_mordred_matrix(X_raw)
+
+    return X_mf, X_md, kept_cols
+
+
+def build_compound_features(smiles_list, cpv_vec, mordred_clean_cols=None):
+    """
+    Compute X = concat(MACCS, Mordred, CPV) for each compound.
+    CPV is broadcast (same for all compounds in the dataset).
+
+    Returns (X, kept_md_cols)
+    """
+    X_mf, X_md, kept_md_cols = compute_mol_features(smiles_list, mordred_clean_cols)
+    n = len(smiles_list)
+    cpv_broadcast = np.tile(cpv_vec, (n, 1))
+    X = np.concatenate([X_mf, X_md, cpv_broadcast], axis=1).astype(np.float32)
+    return X, kept_md_cols
+
+
+# ── Collect RepoRT datasets for pretraining ────────────────────────────────────
+
+def find_report_datasets(data_root, mode="rp"):
+    """
+    Find all RepoRT subset IDs with preprocessed graph data, filtered by LC mode.
+
+    Uses the metadata TSV chromatographic mode:
+      HILIC: column.usp.code starts with "L" and column type is amide/HILIC,
+             OR mobile phase has significant ACN with low %H2O at start
+    For simplicity: check if the dataset's metadata TSV exists and try to detect mode
+    from solvent composition (high initial ACN = HILIC indicator).
+
+    Returns list of dataset names (e.g. ['report0001', 'report0002', ...])
+    """
+    graph_dir = os.path.join(data_root, "processed_graph")
+    all_npz = glob.glob(os.path.join(graph_dir, "dataset_graph_report*.npz"))
+    all_datasets = [os.path.basename(f).replace("dataset_graph_", "").replace(".npz", "")
+                    for f in all_npz]
+
+    # Filter to the requested mode using simple heuristic from metadata
+    result = []
+    for ds in all_datasets:
+        report_id = get_report_id(ds)
+        try:
+            meta = load_metadata(data_root, report_id)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            continue
+        is_hilic = _detect_hilic(meta)
+        if (mode == "hilic" and is_hilic) or (mode == "rp" and not is_hilic):
+            result.append(ds)
+    return result
+
+
+def _detect_hilic(meta):
+    """
+    HILIC detection using RepoRT metadata column names (column.usp.code, eluent.A.acn/meoh):
+      - column.usp.code in known HILIC codes (L68, L114, L163, L120, L60)
+      - OR eluent.A.acn > 50 or eluent.A.meoh > 50 (high initial organic = HILIC)
+    """
+    usp = str(meta.get("column.usp.code", "")).upper()
+    hilic_usp = {"L68", "L114", "L163", "L120", "L60"}
+    if usp in hilic_usp:
+        return True
+
+    acn_a = float(meta.get("eluent.A.acn", 0) or 0)
+    meoh_a = float(meta.get("eluent.A.meoh", 0) or 0)
+    if acn_a > 50 or meoh_a > 50:
+        return True
+
+    return False
+
+
+# ── Pre-training ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def build_pretrain_data(source_datasets, data_root, cpv_encoder, device):
+    """
+    Build combined feature matrix for pretraining.
+
+    For each source dataset: compute MACCS + Mordred + CPV, concatenate all.
+    Returns (X, y, mordred_kept_cols)
+    """
+    all_X = []
+    all_y = []
+    mordred_kept_cols = None  # determined from first large dataset
+
+    for ds in source_datasets:
+        npz = os.path.join(data_root, "processed_graph", f"dataset_graph_{ds}.npz")
+        if not os.path.exists(npz):
+            continue
+        smiles_raw, rt_raw = load_smiles_and_rt(npz)
+        canon_smiles, rt_arr, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_raw, rt_raw)
+
+        report_id = get_report_id(ds)
+        meta = load_metadata(data_root, report_id)
+        cpv_vec = cpv_encoder.encode(meta, device=device)
+
+        X_ds, kept_cols = build_compound_features(canon_smiles, cpv_vec, mordred_kept_cols)
+        if mordred_kept_cols is None:
+            mordred_kept_cols = kept_cols
+
+        all_X.append(X_ds)
+        all_y.append(rt_arr)
+
+    if not all_X:
+        raise ValueError("No source datasets found for pretraining")
+
+    X = np.concatenate(all_X, axis=0)
+    y = np.concatenate(all_y, axis=0)
+    return X, y, mordred_kept_cols
+
+
+def pretrain_model(X, y, input_size, cfg, device, save_path):
+    """Pre-train MDL model on combined source data."""
+    if os.path.exists(save_path):
+        print(f"  [li2025] Loading pretrained checkpoint: {save_path}")
+        return
+
+    y_mean, y_std = float(np.mean(y)), float(np.std(y))
+    if y_std < 1e-8:
+        y_std = 1.0
+    y_norm = (y - y_mean) / y_std
+
+    model = MDLModel(input_size).to(device)
+    X_t = torch.from_numpy(X).float().to(device)
+    y_t = torch.from_numpy(y_norm.astype(np.float32)).to(device)
+
+    n = X.shape[0]
+    val_size = int(0.1 * n)
+    perm = np.random.RandomState(42).permutation(n)
+    val_idx, tr_idx = perm[:val_size], perm[val_size:]
+
+    ds_tr = TensorDataset(X_t[tr_idx], y_t[tr_idx])
+    loader = DataLoader(ds_tr, batch_size=cfg["batch_size"], shuffle=True)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg["pretrain_lr"])
+    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
+
+    best_val = float("inf")
+    no_improve = 0
+    for epoch in range(1, cfg["pretrain_epochs"] + 1):
+        model.train()
+        for xb, yb in loader:
+            optimizer.zero_grad()
+            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
+            loss.backward()
+            optimizer.step()
+        model.eval()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            val_pred = model(X_t[val_idx]).cpu().numpy()
+            val_pred_orig = val_pred * y_std + y_mean
+            val_mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(val_pred_orig - y[val_idx])))
+        if val_mae < best_val:
+            best_val = val_mae
+            no_improve = 0
+            torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "y_mean": y_mean, "y_std": y_std,
+                         "input_size": input_size}, save_path)
+        else:
+            no_improve += 1
+        if no_improve >= cfg["pretrain_patience"]:
+            break
+
+    print(f"  [li2025] Pretrained {save_path}: best_val_MAE={best_val:.4f}")
+
+
+# ── Fine-tuning ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def finetune_and_eval(ckpt_path, X_tgt, y_tgt, train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx, test_idx,
+                      rt_mean, rt_std, cfg, device):
+    ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=device)
+    model = MDLModel(ckpt["input_size"]).to(device)
+    model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model"])
+    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(model.output.weight)
+    nn.init.zeros_(model.output.bias)
+
+    y_norm = (y_tgt - rt_mean) / rt_std
+    X_t = torch.from_numpy(X_tgt).float().to(device)
+
+    ds_tr = TensorDataset(X_t[train_sub_idx],
+                           torch.from_numpy(y_norm[train_sub_idx].astype(np.float32)).to(device))
+    loader = DataLoader(ds_tr, batch_size=cfg["finetune_batch_size"], shuffle=True)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg["finetune_lr"])
+    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
+
+    X_val_t = X_t[val_sub_idx]
+    best_val = float("inf")
+    best_state = None
+    no_improve = 0
+    t0 = time.time()
+
+    for epoch in range(1, cfg["finetune_epochs"] + 1):
+        model.train()
+        for xb, yb in loader:
+            optimizer.zero_grad()
+            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
+            loss.backward()
+            optimizer.step()
+        model.eval()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            val_pred = model(X_val_t).cpu().numpy() * rt_std + rt_mean
+        val_mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(val_pred - y_tgt[val_sub_idx])))
+        if val_mae < best_val:
+            best_val = val_mae
+            no_improve = 0
+            best_state = {k: v.cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+        else:
+            no_improve += 1
+        if no_improve >= cfg["finetune_patience"]:
+            break
+
+    train_sec = time.time() - t0
+    if best_state:
+        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+
+    model.eval()
+    t0 = time.time()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        pred = model(X_t[test_idx]).cpu().numpy() * rt_std + rt_mean
+    infer_sec = time.time() - t0
+
+    return compute_metrics(y_tgt[test_idx], pred), train_sec, infer_sec
+
+
+# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Li 2025 MDL-TL baseline")
+    parser.add_argument("-t", "--target", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--n_folds", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument("-s", "--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    parser.add_argument("--device", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--data_root", default="data")
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint_dir", default="baselines/li2025/checkpoints")
+    parser.add_argument("--results_dir", default="baselines/results")
+    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    np.random.seed(args.seed)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.device}" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    mode = get_mode(args.target)
+    print(f"[li2025] Target: {args.target} ({mode.upper()}) | Device: {device}")
+    os.makedirs(args.checkpoint_dir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    cfg = {
+        "pretrain_lr": 1e-3,
+        "pretrain_epochs": 200,
+        "pretrain_patience": 20,
+        "batch_size": 256,
+        "finetune_lr": 1e-3,
+        "finetune_epochs": 500,
+        "finetune_patience": 30,
+        "finetune_batch_size": 64,
+        "val_ratio": 0.1,
+    }
+
+    # ── Step 1: Get source dataset pool ──────────────────────────────────────
+    source_datasets = find_report_datasets(args.data_root, mode=mode)
+    source_datasets = [ds for ds in source_datasets if ds not in ALL_TARGETS]
+    print(f"[li2025] Source pool ({mode}): {len(source_datasets)} datasets")
+
+    # ── Step 2: Train CPV encoder ─────────────────────────────────────────────
+    cpv_ckpt = os.path.join(args.checkpoint_dir, f"li2025_cpv_{mode}.pkl")
+    cpv = CPVEncoder(ae1_hidden=16, ae2_hidden=16, word2vec_dim=10)
+
+    if os.path.exists(cpv_ckpt):
+        print(f"[li2025] Loading CPV encoder: {cpv_ckpt}")
+        cpv.load(cpv_ckpt)
+    else:
+        print(f"[li2025] Training CPV encoder on {len(source_datasets)} source datasets...")
+        source_metas = []
+        for ds in source_datasets:
+            rid = get_report_id(ds)
+            try:
+                meta = load_metadata(args.data_root, rid)
+                source_metas.append(meta)
+            except FileNotFoundError:
+                pass
+        cpv.fit(source_metas, device=str(device), n_epochs=100)
+        cpv.save(cpv_ckpt)
+        print(f"[li2025] CPV encoder saved: {cpv_ckpt}")
+
+    print(f"[li2025] CPV dimension: {cpv.cpv_dim}")
+
+    # ── Step 3: Pre-train model on source pool ────────────────────────────────
+    pretrain_ckpt = os.path.join(args.checkpoint_dir, f"li2025_pretrain_{mode}.pt")
+    if not os.path.exists(pretrain_ckpt):
+        print(f"[li2025] Building pretraining data...")
+        X_src, y_src, mordred_cols = build_pretrain_data(
+            source_datasets, args.data_root, cpv, device)
+        print(f"[li2025] Pretraining data: {X_src.shape}")
+        pretrain_model(X_src, y_src, X_src.shape[1], cfg, device, pretrain_ckpt)
+        # Save Mordred column indices alongside the checkpoint
+        ckpt = torch.load(pretrain_ckpt, map_location="cpu")
+        ckpt["mordred_cols"] = mordred_cols
+        torch.save(ckpt, pretrain_ckpt)
+    else:
+        print(f"[li2025] Pretrained model exists: {pretrain_ckpt}")
+
+    ckpt = torch.load(pretrain_ckpt, map_location="cpu")
+    mordred_cols = ckpt.get("mordred_cols", None)
+
+    # ── Step 4: Encode target dataset ────────────────────────────────────────
+    target_npz = os.path.join(args.data_root, "processed_graph",
+                               f"dataset_graph_{args.target}.npz")
+    smiles_raw, rt_raw = load_smiles_and_rt(target_npz)
+    canon_smiles, rt_arr, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_raw, rt_raw)
+    print(f"[li2025] {args.target}: {len(canon_smiles)} unique compounds")
+
+    target_id = get_report_id(args.target)
+    target_meta = load_metadata(args.data_root, target_id)
+    cpv_vec = cpv.encode(target_meta, device=str(device))
+
+    print(f"[li2025] Computing target features...")
+    X_tgt, _ = build_compound_features(canon_smiles, cpv_vec, mordred_cols)
+
+    # Ensure input_size matches pretrained model
+    stored_input_size = ckpt["input_size"]
+    if X_tgt.shape[1] != stored_input_size:
+        # Pad or trim to match
+        if X_tgt.shape[1] < stored_input_size:
+            X_tgt = np.pad(X_tgt, ((0, 0), (0, stored_input_size - X_tgt.shape[1])))
+        else:
+            X_tgt = X_tgt[:, :stored_input_size]
+
+    # ── Step 5: 5-fold CV fine-tuning ────────────────────────────────────────
+    n = len(canon_smiles)
+    for fold_id in range(args.n_folds):
+        train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(n, cv_id=fold_id,
+                                           n_splits=args.n_folds, seed=42)
+        train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx = random_val_split(train_idx,
+                                                       val_ratio=cfg["val_ratio"],
+                                                       seed=args.seed)
+        rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(rt_arr[train_idx])
+
+        metrics, train_sec, infer_sec = finetune_and_eval(
+            pretrain_ckpt, X_tgt, rt_arr,
+            train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx, test_idx,
+            rt_mean, rt_std, cfg, device,
+        )
+
+        print(f"  [li2025] {args.target} fold {fold_id}: "
+              f"MAE={metrics['MAE']:.4f}, R2={metrics['R2']:.4f} | {train_sec:.1f}s")
+        save_fold_result(args.results_dir, "li2025", args.target,
+                         fold_id, metrics, train_sec, infer_sec)
+
+    save_summary(args.results_dir, "li2025", args.target)
+    print(f"[li2025] Done: {args.target}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/bin/bash
+# Run all baseline methods on all target datasets.
+# Must be run from the project root: bash baselines/run_all_baselines.sh
+#
+# Options:
+#   DEVICE_JU=<id>          GPU index for ju2021        (default: 0)
+#   DEVICE_WANG=<id>        GPU index for wang2023      (default: 0)
+#   DEVICE_LI=<id>          GPU index for li2025        (default: 0)
+#   DEVICE_STIENSTRA=<id>   GPU index for stienstra2025 (default: 0)
+#   N_FOLDS=<k>             number of folds             (default: 5)
+#   SEED=<s>                random seed                 (default: 42)
+#   N_WORKERS=<n>           Mordred parallel workers    (default: 8)
+#
+# Example (4 GPUs):
+#   DEVICE_JU=0 DEVICE_WANG=1 DEVICE_LI=2 DEVICE_STIENSTRA=3 \
+#     bash baselines/run_all_baselines.sh
+
+set -e
+
+DEVICE_JU=${DEVICE_JU:-0}
+DEVICE_WANG=${DEVICE_WANG:-0}
+DEVICE_LI=${DEVICE_LI:-0}
+DEVICE_STIENSTRA=${DEVICE_STIENSTRA:-0}
+N_FOLDS=${N_FOLDS:-5}
+SEED=${SEED:-42}
+
+mkdir -p baselines/logs
+mkdir -p baselines/results
+
+echo "========================================"
+echo " Baseline runner"
+echo " N_FOLDS=$N_FOLDS  SEED=$SEED"
+echo "========================================"
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Preprocessing (sequential — both steps are idempotent; skip if done).
+# Note: wang2023 MG embeddings require the GNN checkpoint produced by
+# wang2023/run.py itself, so we only compute MACCS + Mordred here (--no_mg).
+# run.py handles MG extraction internally after GNN pretraining.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "[pre 1/2] Ju 2021 features (Mordred for SMRT + 11 targets)"
+python baselines/ju2021/preprocess.py --all --n_workers ${N_WORKERS:-8} \
+    >> baselines/logs/preprocess_ju2021.log 2>&1 \
+    || { echo "  FAILED"; tail -20 baselines/logs/preprocess_ju2021.log; exit 1; }
+echo "  done"
+
+echo "[pre 2/2] Wang 2023 features (MACCS + Mordred for SMRT + 11 targets)"
+# Step 1: preprocess SMRT — establishes MD_kept_cols (reference column selection)
+python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py --datasets SMRT --no_mg --n_workers ${N_WORKERS:-8} \
+    >> baselines/logs/preprocess_wang2023.log 2>&1 \
+    || { echo "  SMRT FAILED"; tail -20 baselines/logs/preprocess_wang2023.log; exit 1; }
+# Step 2: preprocess targets aligned to SMRT columns (avoids MD shape mismatch at fine-tune)
+python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py \
+    --datasets report0027 report0183 report0184 \
+               report0263 report0264 report0382 report0383 \
+               report0401 report0420 report0432 report0435 \
+    --align_to baselines/wang2023/data/SMRT_wang2023.npz \
+    --no_mg --n_workers ${N_WORKERS:-8} \
+    >> baselines/logs/preprocess_wang2023.log 2>&1 \
+    || { echo "  TARGETS FAILED"; tail -20 baselines/logs/preprocess_wang2023.log; exit 1; }
+echo "  done"
+
+echo "Preprocessing complete. Starting methods..."
+echo "========================================"
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Ju 2021 — all 11 datasets
+# Pretrain weighted AE + DNN on SMRT, fine-tune on each target.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "[1/4] Ju 2021 (all 11 datasets)"
+python baselines/ju2021/run.py \
+    --n_folds $N_FOLDS \
+    -s $SEED \
+    --device $DEVICE_JU \
+    > baselines/logs/ju2021.log 2>&1 &
+JU_PID=$!
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Wang 2023 — all 11 datasets
+# Uses self-contained GNN encoder (wang2023/gnn_encoder.py).
+# Pretrain GNN on D1 in-silico HILIC, then pretrain 7 adaptive MLPs on
+# SMRT, combination-select per target, 5-fold CV.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "[2/4] Wang 2023 (all 11 datasets)"
+python baselines/wang2023/run.py \
+    --n_folds $N_FOLDS \
+    -s $SEED \
+    --device $DEVICE_WANG \
+    > baselines/logs/wang2023.log 2>&1 &
+WANG_PID=$!
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Li 2025 — all 11 datasets
+# Pretrain two mode-specific DNNs (RP + HILIC), fine-tune on each target.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "[3/4] Li 2025 (all 11 datasets)"
+python baselines/li2025/run.py \
+    --n_folds $N_FOLDS \
+    -s $SEED \
+    --device $DEVICE_LI \
+    > baselines/logs/li2025.log 2>&1 &
+LI_PID=$!
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Stienstra 2025 — all 11 datasets
+# Pretrain two mode-specific Graphormer-RT models (RP + HILIC),
+# fine-tune on each target.
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "[4/4] Stienstra 2025 (all 11 datasets)"
+python baselines/stienstra2025/run.py \
+    --n_folds $N_FOLDS \
+    -s $SEED \
+    --device $DEVICE_STIENSTRA \
+    > baselines/logs/stienstra2025.log 2>&1 &
+STIENSTRA_PID=$!
+
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Wait for all jobs
+# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+echo "Waiting for all methods to complete..."
+wait $JU_PID        && echo "  Ju 2021 done"        || echo "  Ju 2021 FAILED (exit $?)"
+wait $WANG_PID      && echo "  Wang 2023 done"      || echo "  Wang 2023 FAILED (exit $?)"
+wait $LI_PID        && echo "  Li 2025 done"        || echo "  Li 2025 FAILED (exit $?)"
+wait $STIENSTRA_PID && echo "  Stienstra 2025 done" || echo "  Stienstra 2025 FAILED (exit $?)"
+
+echo ""
+echo "========================================"
+echo " All baselines complete."
+echo " Results: baselines/results/summary.csv"
+echo "========================================"
+cat baselines/results/summary.csv 2>/dev/null || echo "(summary.csv not yet written)"

+"""
+Stienstra 2025 — Graphormer-RT baseline runner.
+
+Architecture: Graphormer with global chromatography node.
+Reference: Stienstra et al. Anal. Chem. 2025, 97, 4461–4472.
+GitHub: https://github.com/HopkinsLaboratory/Graphormer-RT
+
+Training strategy (two pretrained models — the matched pool shared with TIMPANI):
+  - RP model: pretrain on RepoRT RP datasets EXCLUDING the RP targets + the union of their
+    near-duplicates (leakage). HILIC model: same over HILIC. Exclusions come from the per-mode
+    file results_screen/pool_exclusion_mode.json (see scripts/compute_pool_exclusion.py).
+  For each target: load mode-matched checkpoint, 5-fold CV fine-tune, record metrics.
+
+Usage:
+  # Run all 13 benchmark targets (default)
+  python baselines/stienstra2025/run.py -s 42 --n_folds 5 --device 0
+
+  # Run a single target
+  python baselines/stienstra2025/run.py -t report0264 -s 42 --n_folds 5 --device 0
+
+  # Skip pretraining (use existing checkpoints)
+  python baselines/stienstra2025/run.py -t report0264 --skip_pretrain --device 0
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import List
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import yaml
+from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset, random_split
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Path setup — allow running from project root or from baselines/stienstra2025/
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+_HERE = Path(__file__).parent
+_BASELINES = _HERE.parent
+_ROOT = _BASELINES.parent
+sys.path.insert(0, str(_ROOT))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(_BASELINES))
+
+from timp.data.utils import (
+    canonicalize_and_dedup,
+    kfold_split,
+    load_smiles_and_rt,
+    normalize_rt,
+    random_val_split,
+)
+from timp.data.evaluate import Timer, compute_metrics, save_fold_result, save_summary
+from timp.models.chrom_encoder import (
+    ChromEncoder,
+    build_chrom_feature_map,
+    get_chrom_features,
+    load_dataset_metadata,
+    TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM,
+    TOTAL_INT_DIM,
+    extract_chrom_features,
+)
+from timp.data.grt_dataset import (
+    GraphormerRTDataset,
+    MultiDatasetPool,
+    build_pretrain_pool,
+    collate_fn,
+)
+from timp.models.graphormer_rt import GraphormerRT
+from timp.models.grt_wrapper import (
+    GraphormerRTWrapper,
+    eval_epoch,
+    fit,
+    load_checkpoint,
+    save_checkpoint,
+)
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Constants
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+METHOD = "stienstra2025"
+# 14 benchmark targets (10 TL-difficult + 4 TL-easy); see config_timp.yaml.
+HILIC_TARGETS = {"report0027", "report0183", "report0185"}   # 0027 kept: 104 compounds after void removal (>=100)
+RP_TARGETS = {
+    "report0262", "report0263", "report0264", "report0382", "report0401", "report0402",
+    "report0420",                                              # TL-difficult (0432/0435 dropped: <100 compounds after non-eluting removal)
+    "report0327", "report0390", "report0391", "report0397",    # TL-easy
+}
+ALL_TARGETS = sorted(HILIC_TARGETS | RP_TARGETS)
+POOL_EXCLUSION_MODE = "results_screen/pool_exclusion_mode.json"   # per-mode matched-pool exclusion
+
+
+def load_config(cfg_path: str) -> dict:
+    with open(cfg_path) as f:
+        return yaml.safe_load(f)
+
+
+def get_npz_path(dataset_id: str, data_dir: str) -> str:
+    return os.path.join(data_dir, f"dataset_graph_{dataset_id}.npz")
+
+
+def build_model(cfg: dict) -> GraphormerRTWrapper:
+    return GraphormerRTWrapper(
+        emb_dim=cfg.get("emb_dim", 512),
+        n_heads=cfg.get("n_heads", 64),
+        n_layers=cfg.get("n_encoder_layers", 8),
+        n_mlp_layers=cfg.get("n_mlp_layers", 4),
+        attn_dropout=cfg.get("attention_dropout", 0.15),
+        dropout=cfg.get("dropout", 0.05),
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Pretraining
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def pretrain_model(
+    mode: str,
+    cfg: dict,
+    data_dir: str,
+    repo_rt_root: str,
+    checkpoint_path: str,
+    device: torch.device,
+    seed: int,
+    exclude_ids: List[str],
+    verbose: bool = True,
+):
+    """
+    Pretrain a Graphormer-RT model on all RepoRT datasets of the given mode, excluding the
+    matched-pool exclusion set (all same-mode targets + the union of their near-duplicates).
+    """
+    if os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
+        print(f"[pretrain] Checkpoint already exists at {checkpoint_path}, skipping.")
+        return
+
+    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
+    print(f"[pretrain] Building {mode.upper()} pretraining pool (excluding {len(exclude_ids)} datasets) ...")
+
+    smiles_list, rt_array, chrom_feats, dataset_labels = build_pretrain_pool(
+        mode=mode,
+        exclude_ids=list(exclude_ids),
+        repo_rt_root=repo_rt_root,
+        data_dir=data_dir,
+        max_per_ds=cfg.get("max_compounds_per_dataset", 0),
+    )
+
+    if len(smiles_list) == 0:
+        print(f"[pretrain] WARNING: empty {mode.upper()} pool, skipping pretraining.")
+        return
+
+    print(f"[pretrain] Pool size: {len(smiles_list)} compounds")
+
+    rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(rt_array)
+
+    # Train/val split (90/10)
+    n = len(smiles_list)
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    perm = torch.randperm(n).numpy()
+    n_val = max(1, int(n * cfg.get("val_ratio", 0.1)))
+    val_idx = perm[:n_val]
+    train_idx = perm[n_val:]
+
+    train_ds = MultiDatasetPool(
+        smiles_list, rt_array, dataset_labels, chrom_feats,
+        rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, indices=train_idx,
+    )
+    val_ds = MultiDatasetPool(
+        smiles_list, rt_array, dataset_labels, chrom_feats,
+        rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, indices=val_idx,
+    )
+
+    batch_size = cfg.get("batch_size", 64)
+    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+
+    model = build_model(cfg).to(device)
+
+    lr_key = "pretrain_lr_hilic" if mode == "hilic" else "pretrain_lr_rp"
+    lr = cfg.get(lr_key, 1e-4)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8)
+    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
+        optimizer, patience=10, factor=0.5, min_lr=1e-6
+    )
+
+    best_val_loss, train_sec = fit(
+        model=model,
+        train_loader=train_loader,
+        val_loader=val_loader,
+        optimizer=optimizer,
+        scheduler=scheduler,
+        device=device,
+        max_epochs=cfg.get("pretrain_epochs", 250),
+        patience=cfg.get("early_stopping_patience", 20),
+        checkpoint_path=checkpoint_path,
+        rt_mean=rt_mean,
+        rt_std=rt_std,
+        verbose=verbose,
+    )
+
+    # Also save normalization stats alongside checkpoint
+    stats_path = checkpoint_path.replace(".pt", "_stats.npz")
+    np.savez(stats_path, rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std)
+    print(f"[pretrain] Done. Best val loss={best_val_loss:.4f}, time={train_sec:.1f}s")
+    print(f"[pretrain] Checkpoint: {checkpoint_path}")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Fine-tuning + evaluation (5-fold CV)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _degrade_meta(chrom_float, chrom_int, rate, mode, seed):
+    """Metadata-robustness ablation: simulate missing target metadata.
+
+    RepoRT metadata is stored per-dataset and is frequently INCOMPLETE (43% of datasets miss
+    >=1 of 8 condition fields; 22% miss a load-bearing one). We remove a ``rate`` fraction of the
+    target's metadata at fine-tune AND eval, so the comparison is the realistic "deploy on a target
+    whose method is only partially documented" regime (GIN+TIMPANI, which never uses metadata, is
+    rate-invariant).
+      mode='field'  : remove whole semantic FIELDS (gradient, eluent pH, column length / i.d. /
+                      particle / dead-time / temperature / flow, additives, manufacturer, USP --
+                      11 total), replacing each removed field with the model's genuine missing-field
+                      imputation (extract_chrom_features on an empty row). rate = fraction of the 11
+                      fields absent. Faithful "k of 11 metadata fields missing" simulation. PREFERRED.
+      mode='default': per-DIMENSION default imputation (rougher: can split multi-hot categoricals).
+      mode='zero'   : per-dimension zero-fill; injects out-of-distribution values (0 mm / 0 K) for
+                      physical fields -- corruption, not "missing". Reference only.
+      mode='shuffle': corrupted fields -> values permuted within the vector (wrong condition).
+    Returns degraded copies; rate=0 is the untouched clean baseline."""
+    if rate <= 0:
+        return chrom_float, chrom_int
+    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+    cf, ci = chrom_float.copy(), chrom_int.copy()
+    df, di = len(cf), len(ci)
+
+    if mode in ("field", "default"):
+        import pandas as pd
+        from timp.models.chrom_encoder import (
+            extract_chrom_features, N_ADDITIVES, N_MANUFACTURERS, N_USP_CODES,
+        )
+        def_f, def_i = extract_chrom_features(pd.Series(dtype=object), None)
+
+    if mode == "field":
+        A = 2 * N_ADDITIVES
+        fields = [                       # (vector, start, stop) for each semantic metadata field
+            ("f", 0, 7),                                 # gradient program
+            ("f", 7, 9),                                 # eluent pH (channels A, B)
+            ("f", 9, 10),                                # column length
+            ("f", 10, 11),                               # column i.d.
+            ("f", 11, 12),                               # particle size
+            ("f", 12, 13),                               # dead time
+            ("f", 13, 14),                               # temperature
+            ("f", 14, 15),                               # flow rate
+            ("i", 0, A),                                 # additives (channels A+B)
+            ("i", A, A + N_MANUFACTURERS),               # column manufacturer
+            ("i", A + N_MANUFACTURERS, A + N_MANUFACTURERS + N_USP_CODES),  # USP code
+        ]
+        kf = int(round(rate * len(fields)))
+        for fi in rng.choice(len(fields), size=kf, replace=False):
+            vec, a, b = fields[fi]
+            if vec == "f": cf[a:b] = def_f[a:b]
+            else:          ci[a:b] = def_i[a:b]
+        return cf.astype(np.float32), ci.astype(np.float32)
+
+    # per-dimension modes (default / zero / shuffle)
+    k = int(round(rate * (df + di)))
+    for j in rng.choice(df + di, size=k, replace=False):
+        if j < df:
+            if mode == "zero":      cf[j] = 0.0
+            elif mode == "default": cf[j] = def_f[j]
+            else:                   cf[j] = cf[rng.randint(df)]   # shuffle
+        else:
+            if mode == "zero":      ci[j - df] = 0.0
+            elif mode == "default": ci[j - df] = def_i[j - df]
+            else:                   ci[j - df] = ci[rng.randint(di)]
+    return cf.astype(np.float32), ci.astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def run_target(
+    target_id: str,
+    cfg: dict,
+    data_dir: str,
+    repo_rt_root: str,
+    results_dir: str,
+    device: torch.device,
+    seed: int,
+    n_folds: int,
+    pretrain_ckpt: str,
+    verbose: bool = True,
+    degrade_rate: float = 0.0,
+    degrade_mode: str = "zero",
+    method_label: str = METHOD,
+):
+    """
+    5-fold CV fine-tune and evaluate on a single target dataset.
+    """
+    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
+    print(f"[{METHOD}] Target: {target_id}")
+
+    npz_path = get_npz_path(target_id, data_dir)
+    if not os.path.exists(npz_path):
+        print(f"[{METHOD}] ERROR: NPZ not found: {npz_path}")
+        return
+
+    # Load data
+    smiles_list, rt_array = load_smiles_and_rt(npz_path)
+    canon_smiles, canon_rt, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_list, rt_array)
+    n = len(canon_smiles)
+    print(f"[{METHOD}] Loaded {n} compounds after dedup")
+
+    # Load chromatographic metadata (real RepoRT column + gradient + eluent features)
+    chrom_float, chrom_int = get_chrom_features(target_id, repo_rt_root)
+    if degrade_rate > 0:                     # metadata-robustness ablation (missing/unreliable metadata)
+        chrom_float, chrom_int = _degrade_meta(chrom_float, chrom_int, degrade_rate, degrade_mode, seed)
+        print(f"[{METHOD}] metadata degraded: mode={degrade_mode} rate={degrade_rate} "
+              f"-> label {method_label}")
+
+    # NOTE: fine-tune + eval use per-fold, train-only normalization (rt_mean/rt_std computed
+    # below from train_rt_arr). The pretrain-set stats are intentionally NOT loaded here — a
+    # whole-target-set fallback (mean/std over canon_rt including the test fold) would be a
+    # normalization leak if ever wired into eval. Kept out on purpose.
+
+    os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    for fold_idx in range(n_folds):
+        print(f"\n  [fold {fold_idx+1}/{n_folds}]")
+
+        # Compound-level fold split
+        train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(canon_smiles, fold_idx, n_splits=n_folds, seed=42)
+        train_smi = [canon_smiles[i] for i in train_idx]
+        train_rt_arr = canon_rt[train_idx]
+
+        # Inner train/val split

+        val_ds = GraphormerRTDataset(

+        )
+        test_ds = GraphormerRTDataset(
+            canon_smiles, canon_rt, chrom_float, chrom_int,

+        )
+
+        batch_size = cfg.get("batch_size", 64)
+        train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)

+        test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+
+        # Load pretrained model

+
+        lr = cfg.get("finetune_lr", 5e-5)
+        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8)
+        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
+            optimizer, patience=10, factor=0.5, min_lr=1e-7

+        fold_ckpt = os.path.join(
+            results_dir, f"tmp_{METHOD}_{target_id}_fold{fold_idx}.pt"
+        )
+
+        t_train_start = time.time()
+        best_val_loss, _ = fit(
+            model=model,
+            train_loader=train_loader,
+            val_loader=val_loader,
+            optimizer=optimizer,
+            scheduler=scheduler,

+    save_summary(results_dir=results_dir, method=method_label, target_dataset=target_id)

+"""
+Self-contained GNN-RT encoder for Wang 2023 (MDC-ANN) MG feature extraction.
+
+Implements the same architecture as Yang 2021 (Qiong-Yang/GNN-RT):
+  - r=1 neighborhood substructure encoding (atom type + neighbor context)
+  - 10-layer message-passing GNN (skip + neighbor sum aggregation)
+  - Sum readout → 48-dim molecular vector (MG feature)
+
+Fully independent — no imports from yang2021/.
+
+The pretrained model is trained by wang2023/run.py on the D1 in-silico HILIC
+dataset (same D1 used by Yang 2021). The 48-dim molecular vector is then
+filtered to remove features with >60% zero values (~25 dim), and used as
+the "MG" representation in Wang 2023's feature combination scheme.
+
+Reference:
+  Yang et al. J. Cheminform. 2021, 13, 67.
+  Wang et al. Anal. Chim. Acta 2023, 1254, 341100.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from collections import defaultdict
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Atom / bond type vocabularies (r=1 substructure encoding)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+ATOM_TYPES = [
+    "C", "N", "O", "S", "F", "Si", "P", "Cl", "Br",
+    "Na", "K", "Ca", "Fe", "Co", "Al", "B", "Mg",
+    "I", "Se", "H", "other",
+]
+
+BOND_TYPES = ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "AROMATIC", "other"]
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# r=1 substructure encoding
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _atom_symbol(atom) -> str:
+    sym = atom.GetSymbol()
+    return sym if sym in ATOM_TYPES else "other"
+
+
+def _bond_type_str(bond) -> str:
+    bt = str(bond.GetBondType())
+    for name in ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "AROMATIC"]:
+        if name in bt:
+            return name
+    return "other"
+
+
+def mol_to_substructure_keys(mol) -> List[Tuple]:
+    """
+    For each atom, compute its r=1 substructure key:
+      (core_atom_type, sorted_tuple_of_(neighbor_atom_type, bond_type))
+    Returns a list of tuples, one per atom.
+    """
+    keys = []
+    for atom in mol.GetAtoms():
+        core = _atom_symbol(atom)
+        neighbors = []
+        for bond in atom.GetBonds():
+            nb = bond.GetOtherAtom(atom)
+            neighbors.append((_atom_symbol(nb), _bond_type_str(bond)))
+        neighbors_sorted = tuple(sorted(neighbors))
+        keys.append((core, neighbors_sorted))
+    return keys
+
+
+def build_vocabulary(smiles_list: List[str]) -> Dict[Tuple, int]:
+    """
+    Build a vocabulary mapping substructure key → integer index.
+    Index 0 is reserved for padding/unknown.
+    """
+    vocab: Dict[Tuple, int] = {}
+    idx = 1  # start at 1; 0 = padding
+    for smi in smiles_list:
+        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(str(smi))
+        if mol is None:
+            continue
+        for key in mol_to_substructure_keys(mol):
+            if key not in vocab:
+                vocab[key] = idx
+                idx += 1
+    return vocab
+
+
+def mol_to_substructure_indices(mol, vocab: Dict[Tuple, int]) -> List[int]:
+    """Map each atom in mol to its vocabulary index (0 if not in vocab)."""
+    return [vocab.get(key, 0) for key in mol_to_substructure_keys(mol)]
+
+
+def save_vocabulary(vocab: Dict[Tuple, int], path: str):
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+    # JSON-serialize: convert tuple keys to strings
+    serial = {json.dumps(list(k[0:1]) + [list(x) for x in k[1]]): v
+              for k, v in vocab.items()}
+    with open(path, "w") as f:
+        json.dump(serial, f)
+
+
+def load_vocabulary(path: str) -> Dict[Tuple, int]:
+    with open(path) as f:
+        serial = json.load(f)
+    vocab = {}
+    for key_str, v in serial.items():
+        parts = json.loads(key_str)
+        core = parts[0]
+        neighbors = tuple(tuple(x) for x in parts[1:])
+        vocab[(core, neighbors)] = v
+    return vocab
+
+
+def vocab_size(vocab: Dict[Tuple, int]) -> int:
+    return max(vocab.values()) + 1 if vocab else 1
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# GNN model
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+class GNNLayer(nn.Module):
+    """
+    Single GNN message-passing layer.
+    X_i += sum_j(Linear(X_j)) + X_i   (skip connection + neighbor sum)
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, emb_dim: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.linear = nn.Linear(emb_dim, emb_dim, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, edge_index: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # x: (N, D)
+        # edge_index: (2, E) — src, dst
+        if edge_index.shape[1] == 0:
+            return x
+        src, dst = edge_index[0], edge_index[1]
+        msg = self.linear(x[src])  # (E, D)
+        agg = torch.zeros_like(x)
+        agg.scatter_add_(0, dst.unsqueeze(1).expand_as(msg), msg)
+        return x + agg
+
+
+class GNNRT(nn.Module):
+    """
+    GNN-RT for molecular graph embedding (Wang 2023 / Yang 2021 architecture).
+
+    Architecture:
+      Embedding: nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim)
+      10 × GNNLayer (skip + neighbor sum)
+      Readout: sum over atoms → emb_dim vector  (this is the MG feature)
+      10 × Linear(emb_dim, emb_dim) + ReLU
+      Output: Linear(emb_dim, 1) → predicted RT
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        emb_dim: int = 48,
+        n_gnn_layers: int = 10,
+        n_fc_layers: int = 10,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim, padding_idx=0)
+        self.gnn_layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [GNNLayer(emb_dim) for _ in range(n_gnn_layers)]
+        )
+        fc_layers = []
+        for _ in range(n_fc_layers):
+            fc_layers += [nn.Linear(emb_dim, emb_dim), nn.ReLU()]
+        self.fc_layers = nn.Sequential(*fc_layers)
+        self.output = nn.Linear(emb_dim, 1)
+
+    def get_mol_vec(
+        self,
+        subst_indices: torch.Tensor,  # (N,) atom substructure indices
+        edge_index: torch.Tensor,     # (2, E) edges
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Extract 48-dim molecular vector (before FC layers)."""
+        x = self.embedding(subst_indices)
+        for layer in self.gnn_layers:
+            x = layer(x, edge_index)
+        return x.sum(0)  # sum readout → (emb_dim,)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        subst_indices: torch.Tensor,  # (N,)
+        edge_index: torch.Tensor,     # (2, E)
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        mol_vec = self.get_mol_vec(subst_indices, edge_index)
+        return self.output(self.fc_layers(mol_vec))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Batch MG embedding extraction
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def extract_mg_embeddings(
+    smiles_list: List[str],
+    vocab: Dict[Tuple, int],
+    model: GNNRT,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """
+    Extract 48-dim GNN-RT molecular vectors for each SMILES.
+    Returns np.ndarray of shape (N, emb_dim).
+    """
+    emb_dim = model.embedding.embedding_dim
+    model.eval()
+    embeddings = []
+    for smi in smiles_list:
+        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(str(smi))
+        if mol is None:
+            embeddings.append(np.zeros(emb_dim, dtype=np.float32))
+            continue
+
+        indices = mol_to_substructure_indices(mol, vocab)
+        src, dst = [], []
+        for bond in mol.GetBonds():
+            i, j = bond.GetBeginAtomIdx(), bond.GetEndAtomIdx()
+            src += [i, j]
+            dst += [j, i]
+
+        subst_t = torch.tensor(indices, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+        edge_t = torch.tensor([src, dst], dtype=torch.long, device=device) \
+            if src else torch.zeros((2, 0), dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+
+        mol_vec = model.get_mol_vec(subst_t, edge_t)
+        embeddings.append(mol_vec.cpu().numpy())
+
+    return np.stack(embeddings, axis=0).astype(np.float32)

+"""
+MDC-ANN model from Wang et al. 2023.
+
+Architecture:
+  - Input: concatenation of selected molecular representations
+  - Adaptive MLP: input_size → [N, N*0.8, N*0.6, N*0.4, N*0.2] → 1
+    where N = 10^(len(str(input_size)) - 1)
+  - 3 candidate representations (k=3):
+    MF: MACCS fingerprints (166 bits)
+    MD: Mordred descriptors (1,156 dim after cleaning)
+    MG: Yang 2021 GNN-RT molecular graph vector (25 dim after zero-filtering)
+  - Auto-select best combination per target (7 subsets of {MF, MD, MG})
+
+Reference: Wang X et al., J. Chromatogr. B 2023, 1217, 123624.
+"""
+import math
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+
+def adaptive_hidden_dims(input_size):
+    """
+    Compute hidden layer sizes from input_size per Wang 2023 paper.
+
+    N = 10^(len(str(input_size)) - 1)
+    Hidden: [N*1.0, N*0.8, N*0.6, N*0.4, N*0.2]
+    """
+    n_digits = len(str(input_size))
+    N = 10 ** (n_digits - 1)
+    return [
+        max(1, round(N * 1.0)),
+        max(1, round(N * 0.8)),
+        max(1, round(N * 0.6)),
+        max(1, round(N * 0.4)),
+        max(1, round(N * 0.2)),
+    ]
+
+
+class AdaptiveMLP(nn.Module):
+    """
+    Adaptive MLP whose depth and width are determined by input_size.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    input_size : int — total input feature dimension
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, input_size):
+        super().__init__()
+        hidden_dims = adaptive_hidden_dims(input_size)
+        layers = []
+        prev = input_size
+        for h in hidden_dims:
+            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))
+            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
+            prev = h
+        self.hidden = nn.Sequential(*layers)
+        self.output = nn.Linear(prev, 1)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return self.output(self.hidden(x)).squeeze(-1)
+
+
+# Representation subset names and their feature dims
+# (actual dims filled in at preprocessing time)
+REPR_NAMES = ["MF", "MD", "MG"]
+SUBSETS = [
+    ("MF",),
+    ("MD",),
+    ("MG",),
+    ("MF", "MD"),
+    ("MF", "MG"),
+    ("MD", "MG"),
+    ("MF", "MD", "MG"),
+]
+
+
+def concat_reprs(features_dict, subset):
+    """
+    Concatenate representation arrays for a given subset.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    features_dict : dict[str, np.ndarray] — keys: 'MF', 'MD', 'MG'; values: (N, D_i) arrays
+    subset        : tuple[str]
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    X : np.ndarray shape (N, sum_D_i)
+    """
+    import numpy as np
+    parts = [features_dict[r] for r in subset]
+    return np.concatenate(parts, axis=1)

+"""
+Precompute MACCS + Mordred + MG features for SMRT and 11 targets (Wang 2023).
+
+MG features use the self-contained gnn_encoder in this directory — no dependency
+on yang2021/. The GNN-RT model must be pretrained first via wang2023/run.py
+(or by passing --gnn_ckpt and --gnn_vocab to this script).
+
+Usage:
+    # MACCS + Mordred only (no GNN model needed):
+    python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py --datasets SMRT report0184 --no_mg
+
+    # Full (with MG embeddings):
+    python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py --datasets SMRT \
+        --gnn_ckpt baselines/wang2023/checkpoints/wang2023_gnn_pretrain.pt \
+        --gnn_vocab baselines/wang2023/data/vocab.json
+"""
+
+import os
+import sys
+import argparse
+import numpy as np
+
+_BASELINES_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, _BASELINES_DIR)
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(_BASELINES_DIR))
+
+from common.data_utils import load_smiles_and_rt, canonicalize_and_dedup
+from common.fingerprint import (
+    compute_maccs, compute_mordred_batch, clean_mordred_matrix_5nn
+)
+
+TARGET_DATASETS = [
+    "report0027", "report0183", "report0184",
+    "report0263", "report0264", "report0382",
+    "report0383", "report0401", "report0420",
+    "report0432", "report0435",
+]
+
+
+def compute_mg_embeddings(smiles_list, gnn_ckpt, gnn_vocab_path, device_str="cpu"):
+    """
+    Extract 48-dim MG embeddings using the self-contained wang2023.gnn_encoder.
+    """
+    import torch
+    from wang2023.gnn_encoder import (
+        load_vocabulary, vocab_size, GNNRT, extract_mg_embeddings
+    )
+
+    device = torch.device(device_str)
+    vocab = load_vocabulary(gnn_vocab_path)
+    vs = vocab_size(vocab)
+    model = GNNRT(vocab_size=vs, emb_dim=48, n_gnn_layers=10, n_fc_layers=10)
+    ckpt = torch.load(gnn_ckpt, map_location="cpu")
+    state = ckpt["model"] if "model" in ckpt else ckpt
+    model.load_state_dict(state)
+    model = model.to(device)
+
+    return extract_mg_embeddings(smiles_list, vocab, model, device)
+
+
+def preprocess_dataset(dataset_name, data_root, out_dir,
+                       gnn_ckpt=None, gnn_vocab_path=None,
+                       no_mg=False, mg_zero_thresh=0.6,
+                       device_str="cpu", overwrite=False, n_workers=1,
+                       ref_kept_cols=None):
+    out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{dataset_name}_wang2023.npz")
+    if os.path.exists(out_path) and not overwrite:
+        print(f"  Skipping {dataset_name} (already exists)")
+        return
+
+    npz_path = os.path.join(data_root, "processed_graph", f"dataset_graph_{dataset_name}.npz")
+    if not os.path.exists(npz_path):

+
+    smiles_raw, rt_raw = load_smiles_and_rt(npz_path)
+    canon_smiles, rt_array, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_raw, rt_raw)
+    n = len(canon_smiles)

+
+    # MACCS (166-bit)
+    print(f"    Computing MACCS...")
+    try:
+        from tqdm import tqdm as _tqdm
+        _smiles_iter = _tqdm(canon_smiles, desc="MACCS", unit="mol")
+    except ImportError:
+        _smiles_iter = canon_smiles
+    MF = np.stack([
+        (lambda v: v if v is not None else np.zeros(166, dtype=np.float32))(compute_maccs(s))
+        for s in _smiles_iter
+    ], axis=0)
+
+    # Mordred (1,470 raw → Wang 2023 cleaning: 5-NN imputation with MACCS similarity)
+    print(f"    Computing Mordred (n_workers={n_workers})...")
+    X_raw, _ = compute_mordred_batch(canon_smiles, n_workers=n_workers)
+
+    if ref_kept_cols is not None:
+        # Align to reference (SMRT) column selection — apply same columns, impute NaN
+        print(f"\n    Aligning Mordred to reference columns ({len(ref_kept_cols)} cols)...")
+        X_sel = X_raw[:, ref_kept_cols].astype(np.float32)
+        col_median = np.nanmedian(X_sel, axis=0)
+        for j in range(X_sel.shape[1]):
+            nan_mask = np.isnan(X_sel[:, j])
+            if nan_mask.any():
+                X_sel[nan_mask, j] = col_median[j]
+        X_sel = np.nan_to_num(X_sel, nan=0.0)
+        MD = X_sel
+        kept_md_cols = ref_kept_cols
+        print(f"    Mordred aligned: {MD.shape[1]} features")
+    else:
+        print(f"\n    Cleaning Mordred (5-NN imputation)...")
+        MD, kept_md_cols = clean_mordred_matrix_5nn(X_raw, MF)
+        print(f"    Mordred cleaned: {MD.shape[1]} features")
+
+    arrays = {
+        "smiles": np.array(canon_smiles, dtype=object),
+        "rt": rt_array,
+        "MF": MF,
+        "MD": MD,
+        "MD_kept_cols": kept_md_cols,
+    }
+
+    # MG: 48-dim GNN-RT embeddings → filter >60% zeros

+        print(f"    Computing MG embeddings (wang2023 GNN encoder)...")

+"""
+Wang 2023 MDC-ANN: multi-representation combination + adaptive MLP + TL from SMRT.
+
+Fully independent implementation — uses wang2023/gnn_encoder.py for MG features,
+no imports from yang2021/.
+
+Pipeline:
+  0. (Optional) Pretrain GNN-RT on D1 in-silico HILIC data to extract MG features
+  1. Pre-train 7 adaptive MLPs on SMRT (one per combination of {MF, MD, MG})
+  2. For each target dataset:
+     a. Combination selection: fine-tune each of 7 models (10× random splits),
+        pick combination with lowest mean val-MAE
+     b. 5-fold CV: fine-tune selected combination's SMRT checkpoint on target
+
+Usage:
+    python baselines/wang2023/run.py -t report0184 --n_folds 5 -s 42 --device 0
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+import argparse
+import time
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
+
+_BASELINES_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+sys.path.insert(0, _BASELINES_DIR)
+
+from common.data_utils import kfold_split, random_val_split, normalize_rt
+from common.evaluate import compute_metrics, save_fold_result, save_summary
+from wang2023.model import AdaptiveMLP, SUBSETS, concat_reprs
+
+
+# ── Data loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def load_wang_npz(path):
+    data = np.load(path, allow_pickle=True)
+    smiles = list(data["smiles"])
+    rt = data["rt"].astype(np.float32)
+    feats = {}
+    for key in ("MF", "MD", "MG"):
+        if key in data and data[key].shape != ():
+            feats[key] = data[key].astype(np.float32)
+        else:
+            feats[key] = None
+    return smiles, rt, feats
+
+
+def get_available_subsets(feats):
+    """Return only subsets whose representations are all available."""
+    available = [k for k, v in feats.items() if v is not None]
+    return [s for s in SUBSETS if all(r in available for r in s)]
+
+
+# ── Training helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def make_tensor_loader(X, y, batch_size, shuffle, device):
+    X_t = torch.from_numpy(X).to(device)
+    y_t = torch.from_numpy(y.astype(np.float32)).to(device)
+    ds = TensorDataset(X_t, y_t)
+    return DataLoader(ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=shuffle)
+
+
+def train_one_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, criterion):
+    model.train()
+    total = 0.0
+    for xb, yb in loader:
+        optimizer.zero_grad()
+        pred = model(xb)
+        loss = criterion(pred, yb)
+        loss.backward()
+        optimizer.step()
+        total += loss.item() * xb.shape[0]
+    return total / sum(xb.shape[0] for xb, _ in loader)
+
+
+def eval_pred(model, X_t, device):
+    model.eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        return model(X_t.to(device)).cpu().numpy()
+
+
+def finetune_model(model, X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, rt_mean, rt_std, cfg, device):
+    """Fine-tune model; return best val MAE and best state dict."""
+    loader_tr = make_tensor_loader(X_tr, y_tr, cfg["finetune_batch_size"], True, device)
+    X_val_t = torch.from_numpy(X_val).to(device)
+    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg["finetune_lr"])
+    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
+
+    best_val_mae = float("inf")
+    best_state = None
+    no_improve = 0
+
+    for epoch in range(1, cfg["finetune_epochs"] + 1):
+        train_one_epoch(model, loader_tr, optimizer, criterion)
+        pred_norm = eval_pred(model, X_val_t, device)
+        pred_orig = pred_norm * rt_std + rt_mean
+        val_mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(pred_orig - y_val * rt_std - rt_mean
+                                       if False else pred_orig - (y_val * rt_std + rt_mean))))
+        # y_val is already normalized; compare in original units
+        y_val_orig = y_val * rt_std + rt_mean
+        val_mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(pred_orig - y_val_orig)))
+        if val_mae < best_val_mae:
+            best_val_mae = val_mae
+            no_improve = 0
+            best_state = {k: v.cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+        else:
+            no_improve += 1
+        if no_improve >= cfg["finetune_patience"]:
+            break
+
+    if best_state:
+        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+    return best_val_mae
+
+
+# ── Pretrain 7 SMRT models ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def pretrain_smrt_models(smrt_feats, smrt_rt, available_subsets, cfg, device, ckpt_dir):
+    """Pre-train one adaptive MLP per available representation subset on SMRT."""
+    smrt_mean, smrt_std = normalize_rt(smrt_rt)
+    y_norm = (smrt_rt - smrt_mean) / smrt_std
+
+    ckpts = {}
+    for subset in available_subsets:
+        subset_name = "+".join(subset)
+        ckpt_path = os.path.join(ckpt_dir, f"wang2023_smrt_{subset_name}.pt")
+        ckpts[subset] = ckpt_path
+        if os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
+            print(f"  [wang2023] Subset {subset_name}: checkpoint exists, skipping")
+            continue
+
+        X = concat_reprs(smrt_feats, subset)
+        in_size = X.shape[1]
+        model = AdaptiveMLP(in_size).to(device)
+        loader = make_tensor_loader(X, y_norm, cfg["batch_size"], True, device)
+        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg["smrt_lr"])
+        criterion = nn.MSELoss()
+
+        print(f"  [wang2023] Pretraining on SMRT, subset={subset_name}, input_size={in_size}",
+              flush=True)
+        best_loss = float("inf")
+        no_improve = 0
+        for epoch in range(1, cfg["smrt_epochs"] + 1):
+            loss = train_one_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, criterion)
+            if loss < best_loss:
+                best_loss = loss
+                no_improve = 0
+                torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "smrt_mean": smrt_mean,
+                             "smrt_std": smrt_std, "in_size": in_size}, ckpt_path)
+            else:
+                no_improve += 1
+            if epoch % 10 == 0 or no_improve >= cfg["smrt_patience"]:
+                print(f"    epoch {epoch:3d}  loss={loss:.6f}  best={best_loss:.6f}"
+                      f"  no_improve={no_improve}", flush=True)
+            if no_improve >= cfg["smrt_patience"]:
+                break
+        print(f"  [wang2023] Subset {subset_name} done (epoch {epoch}, best_loss={best_loss:.6f})",
+              flush=True)
+
+    return ckpts
+
+
+# ── Combination selection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def select_best_subset(tgt_feats, tgt_rt, available_subsets, ckpts,
+                       cfg, device, n_repeats=10, seed=42):
+    """
+    Evaluate each representation subset via n_repeats random 90/10 splits.
+    Return the subset with the lowest mean val-MAE.
+    """
+    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+    n = len(tgt_rt)
+    subset_maes = {}
+
+    for subset in available_subsets:
+        X = concat_reprs(tgt_feats, subset)
+        ckpt_path = ckpts[subset]
+        if not os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
+            continue
+        ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+        smrt_mean = ckpt["smrt_mean"]
+        smrt_std = ckpt["smrt_std"]
+        in_size = ckpt["in_size"]
+
+        mae_list = []
+        for _ in range(n_repeats):
+            perm = rng.permutation(n)
+            val_size = max(1, int(0.1 * n))
+            val_idx = perm[:val_size]
+            tr_idx = perm[val_size:]
+
+            rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(tgt_rt[tr_idx])
+            y_tr_norm = (tgt_rt[tr_idx] - rt_mean) / rt_std
+
+            model = AdaptiveMLP(in_size).to(device)
+            model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model"])
+            # Reset output layer
+            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(model.output.weight)
+            nn.init.zeros_(model.output.bias)
+
+            X_tr = X[tr_idx]
+            X_val = X[val_idx]
+            mae = finetune_model(model, X_tr, y_tr_norm, X_val, tgt_rt[val_idx],
+                                  rt_mean, rt_std, cfg, device)
+            mae_list.append(mae)
+
+        subset_maes[subset] = np.mean(mae_list)
+
+    best_subset = min(subset_maes, key=subset_maes.get)
+    print(f"  [wang2023] Best subset: {'+'.join(best_subset)} "
+          f"(val MAE={subset_maes[best_subset]:.4f})")
+    return best_subset
+
+
+# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Wang 2023 MDC-ANN baseline")
+    parser.add_argument("-t", "--target", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--n_folds", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument("-s", "--seed", type=int, default=42)
+    parser.add_argument("--device", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--data_dir", default="baselines/wang2023/data")
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint_dir", default="baselines/wang2023/checkpoints")
+    parser.add_argument("--results_dir", default="baselines/results")
+    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    np.random.seed(args.seed)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.device}" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
+    print(f"[wang2023] Target: {args.target} | Device: {device}")
+
+    os.makedirs(args.checkpoint_dir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    cfg = {
+        "smrt_lr": 1e-3,
+        "smrt_epochs": 200,
+        "smrt_patience": 20,
+        "batch_size": 256,
+        "finetune_lr": 1e-3,
+        "finetune_epochs": 500,
+        "finetune_patience": 30,
+        "finetune_batch_size": 64,
+        "selection_repeats": 10,
+        "val_ratio": 0.1,
+    }
+
+    # ── Step 1: Load SMRT features ────────────────────────────────────────────
+    smrt_path = os.path.join(args.data_dir, "SMRT_wang2023.npz")
+    if not os.path.exists(smrt_path):
+        print(f"[wang2023] SMRT features not found: {smrt_path}")
+        print("  Run: python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py --datasets SMRT [--yang_ckpt ...]")
+        return
+    smrt_smiles, smrt_rt, smrt_feats = load_wang_npz(smrt_path)
+    print(f"[wang2023] SMRT: {len(smrt_smiles)} compounds")
+
+    available_subsets = get_available_subsets(smrt_feats)
+    print(f"[wang2023] Available subsets: {['+'.join(s) for s in available_subsets]}")
+
+    # ── Step 2: Pre-train 7 SMRT models ──────────────────────────────────────
+    ckpts = pretrain_smrt_models(smrt_feats, smrt_rt, available_subsets,
+                                  cfg, device, args.checkpoint_dir)
+
+    # ── Step 3: Load target features ─────────────────────────────────────────
+    tgt_path = os.path.join(args.data_dir, f"{args.target}_wang2023.npz")
+    if not os.path.exists(tgt_path):
+        print(f"[wang2023] Target features not found: {tgt_path}")
+        print(f"  Run: python baselines/wang2023/preprocess.py --datasets {args.target} ...")
+        return
+    tgt_smiles, tgt_rt, tgt_feats = load_wang_npz(tgt_path)
+    print(f"[wang2023] {args.target}: {len(tgt_smiles)} compounds")
+
+    # Use same available subsets (filter to those available in both SMRT and target)
+    available_subsets = get_available_subsets(tgt_feats)
+
+    # ── Step 4: Combination selection ────────────────────────────────────────
+    best_subset = select_best_subset(
+        tgt_feats, tgt_rt, available_subsets, ckpts, cfg, device,
+        n_repeats=cfg["selection_repeats"], seed=args.seed,
+    )
+    ckpt_path = ckpts[best_subset]
+    ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
+    in_size = ckpt["in_size"]
+
+    # ── Step 5: 5-fold CV with best subset ───────────────────────────────────
+    n = len(tgt_smiles)
+    X_tgt = concat_reprs(tgt_feats, best_subset)
+
+    for fold_id in range(args.n_folds):
+        train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(n, cv_id=fold_id,
+                                           n_splits=args.n_folds, seed=42)
+        train_sub_idx, val_sub_idx = random_val_split(train_idx,
+                                                       val_ratio=cfg["val_ratio"],
+                                                       seed=args.seed)
+        rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(tgt_rt[train_idx])
+        y_tr_norm = (tgt_rt[train_sub_idx] - rt_mean) / rt_std
+
+        model = AdaptiveMLP(in_size).to(device)
+        model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model"])
+        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(model.output.weight)
+        nn.init.zeros_(model.output.bias)
+
+        t0 = time.time()
+        finetune_model(model, X_tgt[train_sub_idx], y_tr_norm,
+                        X_tgt[val_sub_idx], tgt_rt[val_sub_idx],
+                        rt_mean, rt_std, cfg, device)
+        train_sec = time.time() - t0
+
+        # Inference on test set
+        model.eval()
+        t0 = time.time()
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            pred_norm = model(torch.from_numpy(X_tgt[test_idx]).to(device)).cpu().numpy()
+        infer_sec = time.time() - t0
+
+        y_pred = pred_norm * rt_std + rt_mean
+        metrics = compute_metrics(tgt_rt[test_idx], y_pred)
+
+        print(f"  [wang2023] {args.target} fold {fold_id}: "
+              f"MAE={metrics['MAE']:.4f}, R2={metrics['R2']:.4f} | {train_sec:.1f}s")
+
+        save_fold_result(args.results_dir, "wang2023", args.target,
+                         fold_id, metrics, train_sec, infer_sec)
+
+    save_summary(args.results_dir, "wang2023", args.target)
+    print(f"[wang2023] Done: {args.target}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Experiment runbook
+
+Reproducible commands for the TIMPANI / GIN experiments. Run from the repo root in the `gnn` conda
+env. Backbone is fixed (`GNN_ARCH` in `scripts/run_timp.py` for GIN, `scripts/config_timp.yaml` for
+Graphormer-RT); loss is Huber(δ=1); dedup and per-task RT normalization are always on. This machine
+has 2 GPUs (0, 1) — pass ids explicitly.
+
+## 0. Environment
+```bash
+conda activate gnn            # RDKit + installed `timp` package (pip install -e . if `import timp` fails)
+```
+
+## 1. Data prep (once)
+```bash
+bash scripts/get_data.sh            # clone RepoRT + download METLIN-SMRT
+python scripts/preprocess_graph.py  # -> data/processed_graph/smrt.csv + dataset_graph_report*.npz
+```
+
+## 2. Screen — SC + conventional TL over all datasets
+```bash
+bash scripts/run_screen.sh "0 1"    # shard across GPUs (single GPU: run_screen.sh 0)
+```
+Output: `results_screen/{scratch_gin,tl_gin}_report*.csv` + `summary.csv`. TL-difficult = `tl_gin` R² < 0.8.
+
+## 3. Single run — the `run_timp.py` driver
+`--strategy scratch|tl|timpani`, `--backbone gin|grt`. Example (TIMPANI, GIN):
+```bash
+python scripts/run_timp.py -t report0264 -s 42 --n_folds 5 --device 0 \
+    --backbone gin --strategy timpani --align both --align_meta_batch 4 --meta_steps 4000 \
+    --k_support 16 --k_query 16 --finetune_freeze_encoder \
+    --pool_exclusion results_screen/pool_exclusion_mode.json --results_dir results_timp_benchmark_gin
+```
+
+## 4. Go/no-go — TIMPANI vs TL vs scratch
+```bash
+bash scripts/run_gonogo.sh 0        # GPU id; GRT needs a GPU
+```
+Output: `results_gonogo/summary.csv`. GO if TIMPANI > TL on GIN and ≥ TL on GRT.
+
+## 5. Benchmark — 14 targets at a matched per-mode pool
+Targets (14): difficult 0027 0183 0185 0262 0263 0264 0382 0401 0402 0420 + easy 0327 0390 0391 0397.
+(0432/0435 dropped: 23/52 compounds after void removal, below the 100-compound preprocessing floor.
+0027 kept: 104 compounds after void removal — deduplicating replicate measurements leaves 86 unique.)
+Two near-duplicate pairs are merged into their representatives (report 0184→0183, 0383→0382).
+The pool excludes each target's same-condition replicates (RP 193 / HILIC 28 tasks).
+```bash
+python scripts/compute_pool_exclusion.py            # -> results_screen/pool_exclusion{,_mode}.json
+bash scripts/run_timp_benchmark.sh gin 0 1          # GIN track -> results_timp_benchmark_gin/
+bash scripts/run_timp_benchmark.sh grt 0 1          # GRT track -> results_timp_benchmark_grt/ (same pool)
+python baselines/stienstra2025/run.py -s 42 --n_folds 5 --device 0   # GRT SC/TL baseline, all 14 (--skip_pretrain to reuse)
+```
+GIN SC/TL baselines are already in `results_screen/`. Output labels: `timp_gin` / `timp_grt`;
+Stienstra GRT baseline in `baselines/results/summary.csv`.
+
+## 6. External RT baselines — the four-method comparison
+The four comparison baselines (DNNpwa, MDL-TL, MDC-ANN, Graphormer-RT) run from their own drivers:
+```bash
+bash baselines/run_all_baselines.sh   # all four, 5-fold CV, seed 42 -> baselines/results/summary.csv
+```
+Each method uses its authors' published training configuration on the same folds. The three
+non-metadata methods diverge on most low-data folds (catastrophic R²); Graphormer-RT is the only
+stable external baseline and the primary comparison point.
+
+## Conventions
+- Seed 42 (`-s 42`), 5-fold CV, per-task RT normalization, dedup on.
+- Loss Huber(δ=1); fine-tune early-stops (patience 20). GIN TL upstream = METLIN-SMRT; GRT = RepoRT mode-pool.
+- Logs append to `baselines/logs/<...>.log` — read the tail on failure.

+#!/usr/bin/env python
+"""10-target component ablation + paired significance on the alignment step.
+Reads pool_s{seed}/anchor_s{seed}/align_s{seed} rungs (results_gin_batch/summary.csv), averages
+over seeds 42/43/44, and tests +alignment vs pool and vs +anchoring (paired Wilcoxon)."""
+import csv, numpy as np
+from scipy.stats import wilcoxon
+ROOT="/data/yuhhong/TIMPANI"
+TGTS=["report0027","report0180","report0183","report0185","report0262",
+      "report0263","report0264","report0382","report0401","report0420"]
+SEEDS=[42,43,44]
+R={}
+for row in csv.DictReader(open(f"{ROOT}/results_gin_batch/summary.csv")):
+    R[(row["method"],row["target_dataset"])]=float(row["R2_mean"])
+def rung(name,t,s): return R.get((f"{name}_s{s}",t))
+def mean_over_seeds(name,t):
+    vs=[rung(name,t,s) for s in SEEDS]; vs=[v for v in vs if v is not None]
+    return np.mean(vs) if vs else None
+print(f"{'target':10s} {'pool':>6s} {'+anchor':>8s} {'+align':>7s} | {'al-pool':>8s} {'al-anch':>8s}   (mean over 3 seeds)")
+rows=[]
+for t in TGTS:
+    p,a,al=mean_over_seeds("pool",t),mean_over_seeds("anchor",t),mean_over_seeds("align",t)
+    if None in (p,a,al): print(f"{t:10s}  INCOMPLETE  pool={p} anchor={a} align={al}"); continue
+    print(f"{t:10s} {p:6.3f} {a:8.3f} {al:7.3f} | {al-p:+8.3f} {al-a:+8.3f}")
+    rows.append((t,p,a,al))
+if len(rows)==10:
+    P=np.array([r[1] for r in rows]); A=np.array([r[2] for r in rows]); AL=np.array([r[3] for r in rows])
+    print(f"\nmeans over 10 targets: pool={P.mean():.3f}  +anchor={A.mean():.3f}  +align={AL.mean():.3f}")
+    print(f"alignment step vs POOL   : mean d={ (AL-P).mean():+.3f}, Wilcoxon p={wilcoxon(AL,P)[1]:.4f} (n=10, 3-seed means)")
+    print(f"alignment step vs +ANCHOR: mean d={ (AL-A).mean():+.3f}, Wilcoxon p={wilcoxon(AL,A)[1]:.4f} (n=10)")
+    print(f"anchor step   vs POOL    : mean d={ (A-P).mean():+.3f}, Wilcoxon p={wilcoxon(A,P)[1]:.4f} (n=10)  [expect ~ns]")
+    # per-(target,seed) for more power
+    ps,als,ans=[],[],[]
+    for t in TGTS:
+        for s in SEEDS:
+            p,a,al=rung("pool",t,s),rung("anchor",t,s),rung("align",t,s)
+            if None not in (p,a,al): ps.append(p); ans.append(a); als.append(al)
+    ps,als,ans=np.array(ps),np.array(als),np.array(ans)
+    print(f"\nper-(target,seed) n={len(ps)}: align vs pool p={wilcoxon(als,ps)[1]:.4f}; align vs anchor p={wilcoxon(als,ans)[1]:.4f}")
+else:
+    print(f"\n[incomplete: {len(rows)}/10 targets have all three rungs]")

+#!/usr/bin/env python
+"""Aggregate the metadata-degradation experiment: GRT+TL (metadata-aware) as target metadata is
+progressively zeroed, vs the flat metadata-free GIN+TIMPANI line. Prints a rate x target table
+(R2 and MedAE), the per-rate averages, the crossover rate, and saves a curve figure."""
+import os, csv, numpy as np
+import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+ROOT="/data/yuhhong/TIMPANI"
+TGTS=["report0027","report0180","report0183","report0185","report0262",
+      "report0263","report0264","report0382","report0401","report0420"]
+RATES=[0.0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0]
+def label(r): return "stienstra2025" if r==0 else f"stienstra2025_zero{int(round(r*100))}"
+def load(path):
+    d={}
+    if not os.path.exists(path): return d
+    for row in csv.DictReader(open(path)):
+        d[(row["method"],row["target_dataset"])]=(float(row["R2_mean"]),float(row["MedAE_mean"]))
+    return d
+grt=load(f"{ROOT}/baselines/results/summary.csv")
+gin=load(f"{ROOT}/results_timp_benchmark_gin/summary.csv")
+ginR={t:gin.get(("timp_gin",t),(np.nan,np.nan))[0] for t in TGTS}
+ginM={t:gin.get(("timp_gin",t),(np.nan,np.nan))[1] for t in TGTS}
+gin_mean_R=np.nanmean(list(ginR.values())); gin_mean_M=np.nanmean(list(ginM.values()))
+
+print("="*70); print("METADATA DEGRADATION (zero mode) — GRT+TL R2 by rate")
+print(f"{'target':10s}"+"".join(f"  r={r:<4}" for r in RATES)+"   | GIN+TIMP(flat)")
+curveR={r:[] for r in RATES}
+for t in TGTS:
+    cells=[grt.get((label(r),t),(np.nan,np.nan))[0] for r in RATES]
+    for r,c in zip(RATES,cells):
+        if not np.isnan(c): curveR[r].append(c)
+    print(f"{t:10s}"+"".join(f"  {c:5.2f}" if not np.isnan(c) else "   -- " for c in cells)+f"   |  {ginR[t]:.2f}")
+print("-"*70)
+means={r:(np.mean(curveR[r]) if curveR[r] else np.nan) for r in RATES}
+ns={r:len(curveR[r]) for r in RATES}
+print(f"{'GRT mean':10s}"+"".join(f"  {means[r]:5.2f}" if not np.isnan(means[r]) else "   -- " for r in RATES)+f"   |  {gin_mean_R:.2f}")
+print(f"{'(n cells)':10s}"+"".join(f"  {ns[r]:5d}" for r in RATES))
+# crossover: first rate where GRT mean <= GIN+TIMP flat
+cross=next((r for r in RATES if not np.isnan(means[r]) and means[r]<=gin_mean_R), None)
+print(f"\nGIN+TIMPANI flat mean R2 = {gin_mean_R:.3f}")
+print(f"crossover (GRT mean R2 <= GIN+TIMPANI): {'rate '+str(cross) if cross is not None else 'NONE — GRT stays above GIN+TIMPANI at all rates'}")
+comp=len([1 for r in RATES for _ in curveR[r]]); tot=len(TGTS)*len(RATES)
+print(f"cells complete: {comp}/{tot}")
+# figure
+fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(4,3))
+xs=[r for r in RATES if not np.isnan(means[r])]; ys=[means[r] for r in xs]
+ax.plot(xs,ys,"o-",color="tomato",label="GRT+TL (metadata-aware)")
+ax.axhline(gin_mean_R,ls="--",color="cornflowerblue",label="GIN+TIMPANI (metadata-free)")
+ax.set_xlabel("fraction of target metadata removed"); ax.set_ylabel("mean $R^2$")
+ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.set_title("Metadata-degradation robustness",fontsize=9)
+fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{ROOT}/doc/latex/figure/degrade_curve.png",dpi=150)
+print(f"\nsaved figure -> doc/latex/figure/degrade_curve.png")
