+def pretrain_tl(target_id, modes, exclude_ids, cfg, args, device, out_ckpt):
+    """Conventional transfer learning: standard supervised pre-training (per-task minibatches, fixed
+    metadata context, no inner adaptation), saved as an init that Stage-2 fine-tunes on the target.
+    ``--upstream smrt`` = single-source TL from METLIN-SMRT (the GIN baseline); ``--upstream pool`` =
+    multi-source pre-training over the target-agnostic RepoRT pool; ``--upstream single`` = one RepoRT
+    source dataset (--source_ds; pairwise diagnostic). The SMRT/single init is target-independent, so
+    it is pre-trained once and reused across targets (skipped if the checkpoint already exists)."""
+    if os.path.exists(out_ckpt):
+        print(f"[tl] reusing existing pre-train init -> {out_ckpt}")
+        return
+    if args.upstream == "smrt":
+        tasks = [_load_smrt_task(cfg, args)]
+    elif args.upstream == "single":
+        assert args.source_ds, "--upstream single requires --source_ds"
+        assert args.source_ds != target_id, f"[tl] source == target ({target_id}); no valid transfer"
+        tasks = [_load_single_repo_task(args.source_ds, args)]
+    else:
+        tasks = build_tasks(modes, exclude_ids, cfg["repo_rt_root"], min_mols=1,
+                            max_per_ds=args.max_per_ds, max_tasks=args.max_tasks, verbose=True, args=args)
+        assert target_id not in {t["id"] for t in tasks}, f"LEAK: target {target_id} in TL pool"
+        if not tasks:
+            raise SystemExit("[tl] no usable pool tasks")
+    model = _make_model(cfg, args).to(device)
+    opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg.get("pretrain_lr", cfg.get("finetune_lr", 1e-4)))
+    bs = args.k_support + args.k_query
+    model.train()
+    t0 = time.time()
+    for step in range(args.meta_steps):
+        task = random.choice(tasks)
+        n = len(task["graphs"])
+        idx = torch.randperm(n)[:bs].tolist()
+        graphs = [task["graphs"][i] for i in idx]
+        labels = task["labels"][idx].to(device)
+        z = model.task_context(task["ci"].to(device), task["cf"].to(device)) if task["ci"] is not None else None
+        preds = model.predict(graphs, z, device)
+        loss = torch.nn.functional.huber_loss(preds, labels, delta=1.0)
+        opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward()
+        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
+        opt.step()
+        if args.verbose and (step + 1) % max(1, args.meta_steps // 10) == 0:
+            print(f"[tl-pretrain {step+1}/{args.meta_steps}] loss={loss.item():.4f} ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)", flush=True)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_ckpt) or ".", exist_ok=True)
+    torch.save({"model": model.state_dict()}, out_ckpt)
+    print(f"[tl] saved conventional-pretrain init -> {out_ckpt}")
+
+
+def stage2_full(target_id, cfg, args, device, meta_ckpt):
+    """Non-aligned path: full 5-fold fine-tune of the (target-agnostic) meta-init into the target.
+    Self-contained (no baseline import) — only the loaded init differs from scratch."""
+    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
+    canon_smiles, canon_rt, chrom_float, chrom_int = _load_target(target_id, cfg, args)
+    tgt_graphs = [_featurize(s, args) for s in canon_smiles]
+    os.makedirs(args.results_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    n_splits = max(2, args.n_folds)
+    for fold in range(args.n_folds):
+        train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(canon_smiles, fold, n_splits=n_splits, seed=42)
+        rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(canon_rt[train_idx])
+        val_n = max(1, int(len(train_idx) * cfg.get("val_ratio", 0.1)))
+        torch.manual_seed(args.seed + fold)
+        perm = torch.randperm(len(train_idx)).numpy()
+        inner_val, inner_train = train_idx[perm[:val_n]], train_idx[perm[val_n:]]
+
+        if args.backbone in ("gin", "mpnn", "gat"):
+            pack = lambda idx: [(tgt_graphs[i], float((canon_rt[i] - rt_mean) / (rt_std + 1e-8)))
+                                for i in idx if tgt_graphs[i] is not None]
+            model = _make_model(cfg, args).to(device)
+            if meta_ckpt is not None:                       # None -> random init (scratch)
+                model.load_state_dict(torch.load(meta_ckpt, map_location="cpu")["model"])
+            y_true, y_pred, train_sec = gnn_finetune(
+                model, pack(inner_train), pack(inner_val), pack(test_idx), device,
+                lr=cfg.get("finetune_lr", 5e-5), epochs=args.finetune_epochs,
+                patience=cfg.get("early_stopping_patience", 20), rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std,
+                freeze_encoder=False, batch_size=cfg.get("batch_size", 64), verbose=args.verbose)
+            infer_sec = 0.0
+        else:
+            mk = lambda idx: GraphormerRTDataset(canon_smiles, canon_rt, chrom_float, chrom_int,
+                                                 rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, indices=idx)
+            bs = cfg.get("batch_size", 64)
+            tl = DataLoader(mk(inner_train), batch_size=bs, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+            vl = DataLoader(mk(inner_val), batch_size=bs, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+            tel = DataLoader(mk(test_idx), batch_size=bs, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+            model = GraphormerRTWrapper(
+                emb_dim=cfg["emb_dim"], n_heads=cfg["n_heads"],
+                n_layers=cfg["n_encoder_layers"], n_mlp_layers=cfg["n_mlp_layers"],
+                attn_dropout=cfg["attention_dropout"], dropout=cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+            if meta_ckpt is not None:                       # None -> random init (scratch)
+                load_checkpoint(model, meta_ckpt, strict=True)
+            opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=cfg.get("finetune_lr", 5e-5))
+            sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(opt, patience=10, factor=0.5, min_lr=1e-7)
+            tmp = os.path.join(args.results_dir, f"tmp_{args.method_label}_{target_id}_f{fold}.pt")
+            t0 = time.time()
+            fit(model, tl, vl, opt, sched, device, max_epochs=args.finetune_epochs,
+                patience=cfg.get("early_stopping_patience", 20), checkpoint_path=tmp,
+                rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, verbose=args.verbose)
+            train_sec = time.time() - t0
+            os.path.exists(tmp) and load_checkpoint(model, tmp, strict=True)
+            t1 = time.time()
+            y_true, y_pred, _ = eval_epoch(model, tel, device, rt_mean, rt_std)
+            infer_sec = time.time() - t1
+            os.path.exists(tmp) and os.remove(tmp)
+
+        m = compute_metrics(y_true, y_pred)
+        print(f"[stage2] fold {fold+1}/{args.n_folds}: MAE={m['MAE']:.2f} MedAE={m['MedAE']:.2f} R2={m['R2']:.4f}")
+        save_fold_result(results_dir=args.results_dir, method=args.method_label, target_dataset=target_id,
+                         fold=fold, metrics=m, train_sec=train_sec, infer_sec=infer_sec)
+    save_summary(results_dir=args.results_dir, method=args.method_label, target_dataset=target_id)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- aligned (per-fold)
+def _load_target(target_id, cfg, args):
+    """Target compounds — NPZ if present (GRT-parity path), else the RepoRT TSV (smoke)."""
+    npz = os.path.join(args.data_dir, f"dataset_graph_{target_id}.npz")
+    if os.path.exists(npz):
+        smiles, rt = load_smiles_and_rt(npz)
+    else:
+        smiles, rt = _load_target_tsv(target_id, cfg["repo_rt_root"])
+    # Drop non-eluting (void-plateau) compounds — matches preprocess_graph.determine_thr, so targets
+    # loaded without a pre-filtered NPZ (e.g. report0432/0435) are cleaned consistently. thr=0 (well-
+    # separated datasets) is a strict no-op.
+    rt = np.asarray(rt, dtype=np.float32)
+    thr = determine_thr(rt)
+    if thr > 0:
+        keep = rt > thr
+        n0 = len(rt)
+        smiles = [s for s, k in zip(smiles, keep) if k]
+        rt = rt[keep]
+        print(f"[load] {target_id}: non-eluting filter rt>{thr:.2f} kept {len(rt)}/{n0}", flush=True)
+    canon_smiles, canon_rt, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles, rt)
+    cf, ci = get_chrom_features(target_id, cfg["repo_rt_root"])
+    return canon_smiles, canon_rt, cf, ci
+
+
+def _write_src_weights(results_dir, target_id, seed, accum, fold=None):
+    """Write per-source mean gradient-alignment weight. fold=None -> aggregate over all folds;
+    fold=<int> -> that fold only (file suffixed _fold<fold>)."""
+    import csv as _csv
+    os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    tag = "" if fold is None else f"_fold{fold}"
+    wpath = os.path.join(results_dir, f"srcweights_{target_id}_s{seed}{tag}.csv")
+    with open(wpath, "w", newline="") as f:
+        wr = _csv.writer(f); wr.writerow(["source", "mean_w", "std_w", "n_samples"])
+        for sid, ws in sorted(accum.items(), key=lambda kv: -np.mean(kv[1])):
+            wr.writerow([sid, f"{np.mean(ws):.6f}", f"{np.std(ws):.6f}", len(ws)])
+    return wpath, len(accum)
+
+
+def run_aligned(target_id, modes, exclude_ids, cfg, args, device):
+    """Target-specific + per-fold: for each fold, meta-pretrain with gradient-alignment weighting
+    against the target's TRAIN fold, then fine-tune that fold. Leakage-safe — the test fold never
+    enters Stage 1. Writes per-fold results like the GRT baseline (method = args.method_label)."""
+    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
+
+    tasks = build_tasks(modes, exclude_ids, cfg["repo_rt_root"],
+                        min_mols=args.k_support + args.k_query,
+                        max_per_ds=args.max_per_ds, max_tasks=args.max_tasks, verbose=True, args=args)
+    assert target_id not in {t["id"] for t in tasks}, f"LEAK: target {target_id} in Stage-1 pool"
+    if not tasks:
+        raise SystemExit("[aligned] no usable source tasks")
+
+    canon_smiles, canon_rt, chrom_float, chrom_int = _load_target(target_id, cfg, args)
+    tgt_graphs = [_featurize(s, args) for s in canon_smiles]
+    ci_t = torch.tensor(chrom_int, dtype=torch.float32) if _uses_metadata(args) else None
+    cf_t = torch.tensor(chrom_float, dtype=torch.float32) if _uses_metadata(args) else None
+    print(f"[aligned] target {target_id}: {len(canon_smiles)} compounds, align={args.align}")
+    src_w_all = {} if getattr(args, "log_src_weights", False) else None   # opt-in per-source weight probe (aggregate)
+
+    os.makedirs(args.results_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(args.meta_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    n_splits = max(2, args.n_folds)
+
+    for fold in range(args.n_folds):
+        train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(canon_smiles, fold, n_splits=n_splits, seed=42)
+        if args.subsample_n and args.subsample_n < len(train_idx):
+            # data-efficiency: keep only n train compounds (deterministic). Test fold is untouched,
+            # so the reduced budget hits BOTH the Stage-1 target reference and Stage-2 fine-tune.
+            sel = np.random.RandomState(args.seed + fold).permutation(len(train_idx))[:args.subsample_n]
+            train_idx = train_idx[sel]
+            print(f"[aligned] fold {fold}: subsampled train -> {len(train_idx)} compounds")
+        rt_mean, rt_std = normalize_rt(canon_rt[train_idx])
+
+        # --- Stage 1 (this fold): target reference = the train fold (valid graphs only) ---
+        vt = [i for i in train_idx if tgt_graphs[i] is not None]
+        tgt_ref = {
+            "graphs": [tgt_graphs[i] for i in vt],
+            "labels": torch.tensor((canon_rt[vt] - rt_mean) / (rt_std + 1e-8), dtype=torch.float32),
+            "ci": ci_t, "cf": cf_t,
+        }
+        model = _make_model(cfg, args)
+        trainer = _make_trainer(model, device, args)
+        fold_ckpt = os.path.join(args.meta_dir, f"timp_align_{target_id}_{args.backbone}_s{args.seed}_fold{fold}.pt")
+        # --no_target_anchor: target-agnostic Stage-1 (uniform pool meta-init, target excluded) —
+        # ablation isolating P1 (target anchoring). Stage-2 (frozen, per-fold) stays identical.
+        ref = None if args.no_target_anchor else tgt_ref
+        src_w_fold = {} if src_w_all is not None else None
+        _meta_loop(trainer, tasks, args, fold_ckpt.replace(".pt", "_loss.csv"), tgt_ref=ref, model=model,
+                   src_w_accum=src_w_fold)
+        if src_w_fold is not None:                         # write this fold's weights + merge into aggregate
+            wp, ns = _write_src_weights(args.results_dir, target_id, args.seed, src_w_fold, fold=fold)
+            print(f"[aligned] fold {fold}: wrote per-source weights -> {wp} ({ns} sources)")
+            for sid, ws in src_w_fold.items():
+                src_w_all.setdefault(sid, []).extend(ws)
+        torch.save({"model": model.state_dict()}, fold_ckpt)
+
+        # --- Stage 2 (this fold): fine-tune the fold-specific init (mirrors run_target) ---
+        val_n = max(1, int(len(train_idx) * cfg.get("val_ratio", 0.1)))
+        torch.manual_seed(args.seed + fold)
+        perm = torch.randperm(len(train_idx)).numpy()
+        inner_val, inner_train = train_idx[perm[:val_n]], train_idx[perm[val_n:]]
+        if args.backbone in ("gin", "mpnn", "gat"):
+            # metadata-free GNN: pure-torch fine-tune of the fold-specific init
+            def _pack(idx):
+                return [(tgt_graphs[i], float((canon_rt[i] - rt_mean) / (rt_std + 1e-8)))
+                        for i in idx if tgt_graphs[i] is not None]
+            gmodel = _make_model(cfg, args).to(device)
+            gmodel.load_state_dict(torch.load(fold_ckpt, map_location="cpu")["model"])
+            enc_scale = 0.0 if args.finetune_freeze_encoder else args.finetune_encoder_lr_scale
+            y_true, y_pred, train_sec = gnn_finetune(
+                gmodel, _pack(inner_train), _pack(inner_val), _pack(test_idx), device,
+                lr=cfg.get("finetune_lr", 5e-5), epochs=args.finetune_epochs,
+                patience=cfg.get("early_stopping_patience", 20), rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std,
+                freeze_encoder=(enc_scale <= 0.0), batch_size=cfg.get("batch_size", 64),
+                verbose=args.verbose)
+            infer_sec = 0.0
+        else:
+            mk = lambda idx: GraphormerRTDataset(canon_smiles, canon_rt, chrom_float, chrom_int,
+                                                 rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, indices=idx)
+            bs = cfg.get("batch_size", 64)
+            train_loader = DataLoader(mk(inner_train), batch_size=bs, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+            val_loader = DataLoader(mk(inner_val), batch_size=bs, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+            test_loader = DataLoader(mk(test_idx), batch_size=bs, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
+
+            gmodel = GraphormerRTWrapper(
+                emb_dim=cfg["emb_dim"], n_heads=cfg["n_heads"],
+                n_layers=cfg["n_encoder_layers"], n_mlp_layers=cfg["n_mlp_layers"],
+                attn_dropout=cfg["attention_dropout"], dropout=cfg["dropout"]).to(device)
+            load_checkpoint(gmodel, fold_ckpt, strict=True)
+            # Discriminative Stage-2 fine-tuning: molecular encoder gets base_lr * enc_scale, the
+            # head + condition pathway gets base_lr. enc_scale=0 -> frozen (ANIL); =1 -> full fine-tune.
+            base_lr = cfg.get("finetune_lr", 5e-5)
+            enc_scale = 0.0 if args.finetune_freeze_encoder else args.finetune_encoder_lr_scale
+
+            def _is_enc(n):
+                return (n.startswith("graphormer.") and not n.startswith("graphormer.mlp.")
+                        and not n.startswith("graphormer.chrom_proj."))
+            enc_p = [prm for n, prm in gmodel.named_parameters() if _is_enc(n)]
+            rest_p = [prm for n, prm in gmodel.named_parameters() if not _is_enc(n)]
+            if enc_scale <= 0.0:
+                for prm in enc_p:
+                    prm.requires_grad_(False)
+                opt = torch.optim.Adam(rest_p, lr=base_lr)
+                print(f"[aligned] encoder frozen ({len(enc_p)} tensors); {len(rest_p)} head/cond trainable")
+            else:
+                opt = torch.optim.Adam([{"params": enc_p, "lr": base_lr * enc_scale},
+                                        {"params": rest_p, "lr": base_lr}])
+                print(f"[aligned] discriminative LR: encoder={base_lr*enc_scale:.2e}, head/cond={base_lr:.2e}")
+            sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(opt, patience=10, factor=0.5, min_lr=1e-7)
+            tmp = os.path.join(args.results_dir, f"tmp_{args.method_label}_{target_id}_f{fold}.pt")
+            t0 = time.time()
+            fit(gmodel, train_loader, val_loader, opt, sched, device,
+                max_epochs=args.finetune_epochs, patience=cfg.get("early_stopping_patience", 20),
+                checkpoint_path=tmp, rt_mean=rt_mean, rt_std=rt_std, verbose=args.verbose)
+            train_sec = time.time() - t0
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                load_checkpoint(gmodel, tmp, strict=True)
+            t1 = time.time()
+            y_true, y_pred, _ = eval_epoch(gmodel, test_loader, device, rt_mean, rt_std)
+            infer_sec = time.time() - t1
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.remove(tmp)
+        m = compute_metrics(y_true, y_pred)
+        print(f"[aligned] fold {fold+1}/{args.n_folds}: MAE={m['MAE']:.2f} MedAE={m['MedAE']:.2f} R2={m['R2']:.4f}")
+        save_fold_result(results_dir=args.results_dir, method=args.method_label, target_dataset=target_id,
+                         fold=fold, metrics=m, train_sec=train_sec, infer_sec=infer_sec)
+
+    save_summary(results_dir=args.results_dir, method=args.method_label, target_dataset=target_id)
+    if src_w_all is not None:                          # aggregate per-source weights over all folds
+        wp, ns = _write_src_weights(args.results_dir, target_id, args.seed, src_w_all, fold=None)
+        print(f"[aligned] wrote aggregate per-source alignment weights -> {wp} ({ns} sources)")
+    print(f"[aligned] saved results for {target_id}")
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- main
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="TIMPANI: target-aware transfer (Stage 1 + Stage 2)")

+                        "(near-duplicate datasets; see scripts/compute_pool_exclusion.py)")

+                   help="'timpani' (default): within-task support/query, target-anchored + alignment. "
+                        "'pool_support' (variant): sources are the support set, target train fold is the "
+                        "query; inner-adapt on sources, meta-gradient on the target. GIN (metadata-free) only.")
+    # target-specific gradient-alignment weighting (per-fold Stage 1)
+    p.add_argument("--align", choices=["none", "mol", "cond", "both"], default="none",

+    p.add_argument("--align_alpha", type=float, default=0.5, help="both: alpha*a_mol + (1-alpha)*a_cond")
+    p.add_argument("--align_combine", choices=["sum", "prod"], default="sum")

+    # backbone: grt (metadata, Graphormer) or gin (metadata-free, pure-torch GNN)

+    p.add_argument("--backbone", choices=["grt", "gin", "mpnn", "gat"], default="grt")

+    p.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", default=True)
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    if args.upstream is None:                                 # conventional TL from SMRT (GNN) or pool (grt)
+        args.upstream = "pool" if args.backbone == "grt" else "smrt"
+    if args.method_label is None:
+        _pfx = {"timpani": "timp", "tl": "tl", "scratch": "scratch"}[args.strategy]

+
+    with open(args.config) as f:

+    if args.finetune_lr:                     # override the fine-tune learning rate
+        cfg["finetune_lr"] = args.finetune_lr
+    set_seed(args.seed)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.device}" if (args.device >= 0 and torch.cuda.is_available()) else "cpu")
+    print(f"device={device}  target={args.target}  smoke={args.smoke}")

+    mode = mode_of(args.target, cfg)
+    exclude = list(cfg.get("hilic_targets", [])) + list(cfg.get("rp_targets", []))  # exclude ALL targets (GRT parity)
+    if args.pool_exclusion:                                   # matched shared pool: per-mode exclusion
+        with open(args.pool_exclusion) as f:                  #   (all same-mode targets + union near-dups)

+        key = mode.upper()                                    # mode file keys: "RP" / "HILIC"
+        near = emap.get(key, emap.get(args.target, []))       # fall back to a per-target file if given
+        exclude = sorted(set(exclude) | set(near))

+    modes, pool_tag = [mode], mode                      # mode-matched pool (GRT-parity; cross-mode transfer is prior work)
+    if args.strategy in ("tl", "scratch"):

+        print(f"\n=== ALIGNED (per-fold, target-specific): align={args.align} "

+        run_aligned(args.target, modes, exclude, cfg, args, device)

+    print(f"\n=== STAGE 1: meta-pretrain ({'+'.join(modes)} pool, excl. {len(exclude)} targets) ===")
+    stage1_meta_pretrain(args.target, modes, exclude, cfg, args, device, meta_ckpt)

+    else:
+        stage2_full(args.target, cfg, args, device, meta_ckpt)

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# TIMPANI (target-anchored meta-init + frozen-encoder Stage-2) on the 14 benchmark targets —
+# 10 TL-difficult + 4 TL-easy (post-audit set). Mode-matched pool.
+# Per-target near-duplicate datasets are excluded from the pool via results_screen/pool_exclusion.json
+# (on top of the config's hold-out of ALL 14 targets). The exclusion is backbone-independent (it is
+# computed on 2D SMILES + RT correlation), so both backbones use the SAME pool.
+#
+# Backbone (first arg, default gin):
+#   gin  — metadata-free GNN; SC/TL baselines are in results_screen/ (TL upstream = METLIN-SMRT)
+#   grt  — Graphormer-RT (metadata); TL baseline is pool-based (run separately), needs a GPU
+# This script runs the TIMPANI arm only. Round-robins targets across the given GPUs (one sequential
+# queue per GPU); results go to results_timp_benchmark_<backbone>/.
+#   bash scripts/run_timp_benchmark.sh gin 0 1 2   # GIN track, 3 GPUs
+#   bash scripts/run_timp_benchmark.sh grt 0 1 2   # GRT track, same 14 targets/pool
+#   bash scripts/run_timp_benchmark.sh 0 1 2       # backbone omitted -> gin (back-compat)
+set -uo pipefail
+
+BACKBONE=gin
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "gin" || "${1:-}" == "grt" ]]; then BACKBONE="$1"; shift; fi
+if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then GPUS=("$@"); else GPUS=(0 1 2); fi
+
+# HILIC first (3) then RP (11); round-robin spreads the 3 HILIC across the first GPUs.
+HILIC=(report0027 report0183 report0185)
+# 0432/0435 dropped: <100 compounds after non-eluting removal (fail the preprocessing threshold)
+RP_DIFF=(report0262 report0263 report0264 report0382 report0401 report0402 report0420)
+RP_EASY=(report0327 report0390 report0391 report0397)
+TARGETS=("${HILIC[@]}" "${RP_DIFF[@]}" "${RP_EASY[@]}")
+
+OUT="results_timp_benchmark_${BACKBONE}"
+EXCL=results_screen/pool_exclusion_mode.json   # per-mode matched pool (shared with the GRT baseline)
+LOGDIR=baselines/logs
+mkdir -p "$LOGDIR" "$OUT"
+
+run_one() {  # <target> <device>
+  python scripts/run_timp.py -t "$1" -s 42 --n_folds 5 --device "$2" \
+    --backbone "$BACKBONE" --strategy timpani \
+    --align both --align_meta_batch 4 --meta_steps 4000 --k_support 16 --k_query 16 \
+    --max_per_ds 100 --finetune_freeze_encoder \
+    --pool_exclusion "$EXCL" \
+    --results_dir "$OUT" >> "$LOGDIR/timp_${BACKBONE}_${1}.log" 2>&1
+}
+
+run_queue() {  # <device> <target...>  — sequential within one GPU
+  local D="$1"; shift
+  for T in "$@"; do
+    echo "[gpu $D] START $T $(date +%T)"
+    if run_one "$T" "$D"; then echo "[gpu $D] OK   $T $(date +%T)"
+    else echo "[gpu $D] FAIL $T — see $LOGDIR/timp_${BACKBONE}_${T}.log"; tail -20 "$LOGDIR/timp_${BACKBONE}_${T}.log"; fi
+  done
+}
+
+NG=${#GPUS[@]}
+declare -a Q
+for i in "${!TARGETS[@]}"; do            # round-robin targets onto GPU slots
+  gi=$(( i % NG ))
+  Q[$gi]="${Q[$gi]:-} ${TARGETS[$i]}"
+done
+echo "=== TIMPANI (${BACKBONE}) benchmark: ${#TARGETS[@]} targets on GPUs ${GPUS[*]} ==="
+for gi in "${!GPUS[@]}"; do
+  echo "  gpu ${GPUS[$gi]} <-${Q[$gi]}"
+  run_queue "${GPUS[$gi]}" ${Q[$gi]} &   # unquoted: word-split the queue's targets
+done
+wait
+echo "=== DONE. Results in $OUT/ (per-target CSV + summary.csv), logs in $LOGDIR/timp_${BACKBONE}_*.log ==="

+    # Set PyTorch's random seed

+def collate_2D_graphs(batch):
+    g_list, label_list = map(list, zip(*batch))
+
+    g_list = dgl.batch(g_list)
+    label_list = torch.FloatTensor(np.vstack(label_list))

+__all__ = [

+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
+from timp.trainer.base_trainer import baseTrainer
+
+
+def _make_loader(n=10, in_feats=4):
+    x = torch.randn(n, in_feats).double()
+    y = torch.randn(n, 1).double()
+    ds = TensorDataset(x, y)
+    return DataLoader(ds, batch_size=n)
+
+
+def test_inference_shape(mock_model, device):
+    trainer = baseTrainer(mock_model.double(), device)
+    loader = _make_loader(n=8, in_feats=4)
+    mean, std = 0.0, 1.0
+    preds = trainer.inference(loader, mean, std)
+    assert preds.shape == (8, 1)
+
+
+def test_inference_denormalized(mock_model, device):
+    """Output should be mean + std * model_output (not normalized)."""
+    trainer = baseTrainer(mock_model.double(), device)
+    loader = _make_loader(n=4, in_feats=4)
+
+    mean, std = 5.0, 2.0
+    preds = trainer.inference(loader, mean, std)
+
+    # Recompute raw model output with no grad
+    mock_model.eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for batch in loader:
+            x = batch[0].double()
+            raw = mock_model(x).cpu().numpy()
+
+    expected = raw * std + mean
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(preds, expected, rtol=1e-5)

+"""Regression guard for the chromatography-condition extractor.
+
+The bug this catches: the extractor once looked up underscore field names (column_temperature,
+flow_rate, ...) while RepoRT metadata uses dot names (column.temperature, column.flowrate, ...), so
+every lookup missed and EVERY dataset collapsed to the same all-default condition vector — silently
+disabling the metadata conditioning for the Graphormer-RT baseline and TIMPANI-GRT.
+
+These tests use synthetic RepoRT-schema rows (no data files) and assert that real fields actually
+propagate and that different conditions produce different vectors.
+"""
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+from timp.models.chrom_encoder import (
+    extract_chrom_features,
+    _parse_column,
+    _channel_additive_multihot,
+    _gradient_points,
+    TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM,
+    TOTAL_INT_DIM,
+)
+
+
+def _row(**over):
+    """A minimal RepoRT dot-schema metadata row, overridable per field."""
+    base = {

+        "column.length": 100.0, "column.id": 2.1, "column.particle.size": 1.7,

+        "gradient.start.B": 5.0, "gradient.end.B": 95.0,
+    }
+    base.update(over)
+    return pd.Series(base)
+
+
+def test_column_fields_propagate_not_defaults():
+    """Real column values must be read from dot-named fields, not fall back to defaults."""
+    f, _ = _parse_column(_row(**{"column.temperature": 55.0, "column.flowrate": 0.25,
+                                 "column.length": 150.0, "column.particle.size": 2.6}))
+    length, col_id, particle, dead_vol, temp_k, flow = f
+    assert length == 150.0
+    assert abs(particle - 2.6) < 1e-4
+    assert abs(flow - 0.25) < 1e-4
+    assert abs(temp_k - (55.0 + 273.15)) < 1e-2   # 55 C -> K, NOT the 40 C default (313.15)

+def test_different_conditions_give_different_vectors():

+    fa, ia = extract_chrom_features(_row(**{"column.temperature": 25.0, "column.usp.code": "L114"}))
+    fb, ib = extract_chrom_features(_row(**{"column.temperature": 60.0, "column.usp.code": "L1"}))
+    assert fa.shape == (TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM,) and ia.shape == (TOTAL_INT_DIM,)

+def test_eluent_additive_multihot_reads_composition():

+def test_gradient_profile_interpolation():

+"""
+Shared evaluation utilities for all baseline methods.
+Computes MAE, MedAE, R² and writes results to CSV.
+No imports from scripts/ or timp/.
+"""
+import os
+import csv
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from datetime import datetime
+from sklearn.metrics import median_absolute_error, r2_score
+
+
+def compute_metrics(y_true, y_pred):
+    """
+    Compute MAE, MedAE, R² from true and predicted RT values.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    y_true, y_pred : array-like of floats (in original RT units)
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    dict with keys: MAE, MedAE, R2
+    """
+    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
+    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=np.float64)
+    mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(y_true - y_pred)))
+    medae = float(median_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred))
+    r2 = float(r2_score(y_true, y_pred))
+    return {"MAE": round(mae, 4), "MedAE": round(medae, 4), "R2": round(r2, 4)}
+
+
+_FOLD_CSV_HEADER = [
+    "timestamp", "method", "target_dataset", "fold",
+    "MAE", "MedAE", "R2", "train_sec", "infer_sec",
+]
+
+_SUMMARY_CSV_HEADER = [
+    "method", "target_dataset",
+    "MAE_mean", "MAE_std",
+    "MedAE_mean", "MedAE_std",
+    "R2_mean", "R2_std",
+    "train_sec_mean",
+]
+
+
+def save_fold_result(results_dir, method, target_dataset, fold, metrics, train_sec, infer_sec):
+    """
+    Append one fold's result to {results_dir}/{method}_{target_dataset}.csv.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    metrics    : dict with keys MAE, MedAE, R2
+    train_sec  : float — training wall time in seconds
+    infer_sec  : float — inference wall time in seconds
+    """
+    os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    out_path = os.path.join(results_dir, f"{method}_{target_dataset}.csv")
+    write_header = not os.path.exists(out_path)
+
+    row = {
+        "timestamp": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
+        "method": method,
+        "target_dataset": target_dataset,
+        "fold": fold,
+        "MAE": metrics["MAE"],
+        "MedAE": metrics["MedAE"],
+        "R2": metrics["R2"],
+        "train_sec": round(train_sec, 2),
+        "infer_sec": round(infer_sec, 4),
+    }
+
+    with open(out_path, "a", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=_FOLD_CSV_HEADER)
+        if write_header:
+            writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerow(row)
+
+
+def save_summary(results_dir, method, target_dataset):
+    """
+    Read per-fold CSV for (method, target_dataset), compute mean±std, append to summary.csv.
+    """
+    import pandas as pd
+
+    fold_csv = os.path.join(results_dir, f"{method}_{target_dataset}.csv")
+    if not os.path.exists(fold_csv):
+        print(f"[evaluate] No fold CSV found: {fold_csv}")
+        return
+
+    df = pd.read_csv(fold_csv)
+    summary_path = os.path.join(results_dir, "summary.csv")
+    write_header = not os.path.exists(summary_path)
+
+    row = {
+        "method": method,
+        "target_dataset": target_dataset,
+        "MAE_mean": round(df["MAE"].mean(), 4),
+        "MAE_std": round(df["MAE"].std(), 4),
+        "MedAE_mean": round(df["MedAE"].mean(), 4),
+        "MedAE_std": round(df["MedAE"].std(), 4),
+        "R2_mean": round(df["R2"].mean(), 4),
+        "R2_std": round(df["R2"].std(), 4),
+        "train_sec_mean": round(df["train_sec"].mean(), 2),
+    }
+
+    with open(summary_path, "a", newline="") as f:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=_SUMMARY_CSV_HEADER)
+        if write_header:
+            writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerow(row)
+
+    print(f"[{method}] {target_dataset}: MAE={row['MAE_mean']:.4f}±{row['MAE_std']:.4f}, "
+          f"R2={row['R2_mean']:.4f}±{row['R2_std']:.4f}")
+
+
+class Timer:
+    """Simple context manager for timing code blocks."""
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.elapsed = 0.0
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        self._start = time.time()
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *args):
+        self.elapsed = time.time() - self._start

+"""
+Dataset utilities for Graphormer-RT.
+
+Loads RepoRT data from processed npz files + per-dataset metadata TSVs.
+Supports multi-dataset pretraining and single-dataset fine-tuning with 5-fold CV.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from torch.utils.data import Dataset
+
+try:
+    from tqdm import tqdm as _tqdm
+except ImportError:
+    _tqdm = None
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
+
+from timp.data.utils import (
+    canonicalize_and_dedup,
+    load_smiles_and_rt,
+)
+from timp.models.chrom_encoder import ChromEncoder, build_chrom_feature_map
+from timp.models.graphormer_features import smiles_to_graph_data
+
+
+class GraphormerRTDataset(Dataset):
+    """
+    Dataset for Graphormer-RT.
+
+    Each item: (graph_data_dict, rt_normalized, chrom_float, chrom_int)
+    where chrom_float/int are fixed per dataset (same for all molecules in one dataset).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        smiles_list: List[str],
+        rt_array: np.ndarray,
+        chrom_float: np.ndarray,   # (TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM,)
+        chrom_int: np.ndarray,     # (TOTAL_INT_DIM,)
+        rt_mean: float = 0.0,
+        rt_std: float = 1.0,
+        indices: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
+    ):
+        if indices is not None:
+            smiles_list = [smiles_list[i] for i in indices]
+            rt_array = rt_array[indices]
+
+        self.smiles = smiles_list
+        self.rt_norm = (rt_array - rt_mean) / (rt_std + 1e-8)
+        self.rt_raw = rt_array
+        self.chrom_float = torch.tensor(chrom_float, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.chrom_int = torch.tensor(chrom_int, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+        # Pre-convert molecules to graph dicts (cache)
+        self.graphs = []
+        self.valid_mask = []
+        smi_iter = _tqdm(smiles_list, desc="parsing graphs", leave=False) if _tqdm else smiles_list
+        for smi in smi_iter:
+            g = smiles_to_graph_data(smi)
+            self.graphs.append(g)
+            self.valid_mask.append(g is not None)
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        return len(self.smiles)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, idx):
+        return (
+            self.graphs[idx],
+            float(self.rt_norm[idx]),
+            self.chrom_float,
+            self.chrom_int,
+        )
+
+
+def collate_fn(batch):
+    """
+    Collate a batch of (graph_dict, rt, chrom_float, chrom_int) tuples.
+    Filters out None graphs.
+    Returns: (graphs, rts, chrom_floats, chrom_ints) where None-graph items are removed.
+    """
+    valid = [(g, rt, cf, ci) for (g, rt, cf, ci) in batch if g is not None]
+    if not valid:
+        return None, None, None, None
+    graphs, rts, cfs, cis = zip(*valid)
+    return (
+        list(graphs),
+        torch.tensor(rts, dtype=torch.float32),
+        torch.stack(cfs),
+        torch.stack(cis),
+    )
+
+
+def build_pretrain_pool(
+    mode: str,           # "rp" or "hilic"
+    exclude_ids: List[str],
+    repo_rt_root: str,
+    data_dir: str,       # unused — kept for API compatibility
+    max_per_ds: int = 0, # cap per-dataset compounds (0 = no cap)
+) -> Tuple[List[str], np.ndarray, Dict[str, Tuple]]:
+    """
+    Build the pretraining pool for a given mode (RP or HILIC).
+
+    Scans repo_rt_root for all dataset directories that have an info.tsv
+    (authoritative method.type: "RP" or "HILIC") and an rtdata TSV.
+    No graph NPZ files required.
+
+    Returns:
+      all_smiles: flat list of SMILES across all pool datasets
+      all_rt: flat array of RT values
+      chrom_feats: {dataset_id: (float_feats, int_feats)}
+      dataset_labels: dataset ID per compound
+    """
+    import glob as _glob
+    import pandas as pd
+    from timp.models.chrom_encoder import build_chrom_feature_map
+
+    exclude_set = set(exclude_ids)
+    target_mode = mode.upper()  # "RP" or "HILIC"
+
+    # Scan all per-dataset directories for info.tsv (authoritative mode label)
+    info_files = _glob.glob(os.path.join(repo_rt_root, "*", "*_info.tsv"))
+
+    pool_ids = []   # list of (did, rtdata_tsv_path)
+    for info_path in sorted(info_files):
+        numeric_id = os.path.basename(info_path).split("_info")[0]   # "0027"
+        did = f"report{numeric_id}"                                    # "report0027"
+        if did in exclude_set:
+            continue
+        # Read method.type from info.tsv (column 3, row 2)
+        try:
+            info_df = pd.read_csv(info_path, sep="\t", nrows=1)
+            method_type = str(info_df["method.type"].iloc[0]).strip().upper()
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+        if method_type != target_mode:
+            continue
+        # Find the rtdata TSV
+        rtdata_pattern = os.path.join(
+            os.path.dirname(info_path),
+            f"{numeric_id}_rtdata_isomeric_success.tsv"
+        )
+        rtdata_files = _glob.glob(rtdata_pattern)
+        if not rtdata_files:
+            continue
+        pool_ids.append((did, rtdata_files[0]))
+
+    if not pool_ids:
+        print(f"[dataset] WARNING: no {target_mode} pool datasets found (excluding {len(exclude_ids)} targets)")
+        return [], np.array([], dtype=np.float32), {}, []
+
+    print(f"[dataset] {target_mode} pool: {len(pool_ids)} datasets (excl. {len(exclude_ids)} targets)")
+
+    all_smiles, all_rt_list, dataset_labels = [], [], []
+    ds_iter = _tqdm(pool_ids, desc=f"loading {target_mode} pool", leave=False) if _tqdm else pool_ids
+    for did, tsv_path in ds_iter:
+        try:
+            df = pd.read_csv(tsv_path, sep="\t")
+            smiles_col = "smiles.std" if "smiles.std" in df.columns else "smiles"
+            rt_col = "rt" if "rt" in df.columns else "RT"
+            df = df[[smiles_col, rt_col]].dropna()
+            df.columns = ["smiles", "rt"]
+            df["rt"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rt"], errors="coerce")
+            df = df.dropna(subset=["rt"])
+            smiles_list = df["smiles"].tolist()
+            rt_array = df["rt"].values.astype(np.float32)
+        except Exception as e:
+            print(f"[dataset] WARNING: failed to load {tsv_path}: {e}")
+            continue
+        canon_smiles, canon_rt, _ = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_list, rt_array)
+        if max_per_ds and len(canon_smiles) > max_per_ds:
+            rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
+            idx = rng.choice(len(canon_smiles), max_per_ds, replace=False)
+            idx.sort()
+            canon_smiles = [canon_smiles[i] for i in idx]
+            canon_rt = canon_rt[idx]
+        all_smiles.extend(canon_smiles)
+        all_rt_list.extend(canon_rt.tolist())
+        dataset_labels.extend([did] * len(canon_smiles))
+
+    all_rt = np.array(all_rt_list, dtype=np.float32)
+
+    # Build chrom feature map for all pool datasets
+    pool_dataset_ids = [did for did, _ in pool_ids]
+    chrom_feats = build_chrom_feature_map(pool_dataset_ids, repo_rt_root)
+
+    return all_smiles, all_rt, chrom_feats, dataset_labels
+
+
+class MultiDatasetPool(Dataset):
+    """
+    Multi-dataset pretraining pool for Graphormer-RT.
+    Each item has its own chromatographic embedding (from its source dataset).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        smiles_list: List[str],
+        rt_array: np.ndarray,
+        dataset_labels: List[str],    # dataset ID per compound
+        chrom_feat_map: Dict[str, Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]],
+        rt_mean: float = 0.0,
+        rt_std: float = 1.0,
+        indices: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
+    ):
+        from timp.models.chrom_encoder import TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM, TOTAL_INT_DIM
+
+        if indices is not None:
+            smiles_list = [smiles_list[i] for i in indices]
+            rt_array = rt_array[indices]
+            dataset_labels = [dataset_labels[i] for i in indices]
+
+        self.rt_norm = (rt_array - rt_mean) / (rt_std + 1e-8)
+        self.rt_raw = rt_array
+        self.dataset_labels = dataset_labels
+
+        # Pre-convert to tensors
+        chrom_floats, chrom_ints = [], []
+        for did in dataset_labels:
+            if did in chrom_feat_map:
+                cf, ci = chrom_feat_map[did]
+            else:
+                cf = np.zeros(TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
+                ci = np.zeros(TOTAL_INT_DIM, dtype=np.float32)
+            chrom_floats.append(cf)
+            chrom_ints.append(ci)
+
+        self.chrom_floats = [torch.tensor(cf, dtype=torch.float32) for cf in chrom_floats]
+        self.chrom_ints = [torch.tensor(ci, dtype=torch.float32) for ci in chrom_ints]
+
+        # Pre-parse molecular graphs
+        self.graphs = []
+        smi_iter = _tqdm(smiles_list, desc="parsing graphs", leave=False) if _tqdm else smiles_list
+        for smi in smi_iter:
+            g = smiles_to_graph_data(smi)
+            self.graphs.append(g)
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        return len(self.graphs)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, idx):
+        return (
+            self.graphs[idx],
+            float(self.rt_norm[idx]),
+            self.chrom_floats[idx],
+            self.chrom_ints[idx],
+        )

+"""
+Shared data utilities for all baseline methods.
+No imports from scripts/ or timp/.
+"""
+import os
+import glob
+import numpy as np
+from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
+from rdkit import Chem
+
+
+def load_smiles_and_rt(npz_path):
+    """
+    Load SMILES strings and RT values from the source data files.
+
+    The preprocessed graph NPZ files store only graph tensors (no SMILES).
+    This function derives the dataset name from npz_path and reads from the
+    original source files:
+      - SMRT  : <data_root>/SMRT_dataset.sdf  (RT from RETENTION_TIME property)
+      - report*: <data_root>/RepoRT/processed_data/<ID>_*/<ID>_rtdata_isomeric_success.tsv
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    npz_path : str
+        Path to the preprocessed graph NPZ, e.g.
+        "data/processed_graph/dataset_graph_SMRT.npz"
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    smiles_list : list[str]
+    rt_array    : np.ndarray, shape (N,)
+    """
+    # Derive dataset name and data_root from path
+    basename = os.path.basename(npz_path)           # dataset_graph_SMRT.npz
+    name = basename.replace("dataset_graph_", "").replace(".npz", "")  # SMRT or report0184
+    # data_root is two levels up from processed_graph/
+    data_root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(npz_path)))
+
+    if name == "SMRT":
+        sdf_path = os.path.join(data_root, "SMRT_dataset.sdf")
+        if not os.path.exists(sdf_path):
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"SMRT SDF not found: {sdf_path}")
+        suppl = Chem.SDMolSupplier(sdf_path, removeHs=False)
+        smiles_list, rt_list = [], []
+        for mol in suppl:
+            if mol is None:
+                continue
+            try:
+                Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
+                rt = mol.GetDoubleProp("RETENTION_TIME")
+                smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+                smiles_list.append(smi)
+                rt_list.append(rt)
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+        return smiles_list, np.array(rt_list, dtype=np.float32)
+
+    else:
+        # RepoRT dataset — directory is named by numeric ID only (e.g. "0027/"),
+        # not the full "report0027" name used in the NPZ filename.
+        report_root = os.path.join(data_root, "RepoRT", "processed_data")
+        numeric_id = name.replace("report", "")   # "report0027" → "0027"
+        # Try exact dir first, then wildcard suffix
+        for pat in [
+            os.path.join(report_root, numeric_id, f"{numeric_id}_rtdata_isomeric_success.tsv"),
+            os.path.join(report_root, f"{numeric_id}_*", f"{numeric_id}_rtdata_isomeric_success.tsv"),
+            os.path.join(report_root, f"{name}_*", f"{name}_rtdata_isomeric_success.tsv"),
+        ]:
+            matches = glob.glob(pat)
+            if matches:
+                break
+        if not matches:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(
+                f"RepoRT TSV not found for {name}. "
+                f"Tried numeric_id={numeric_id!r} under {report_root}"
+            )
+        tsv_path = matches[0]
+        import pandas as pd
+        df = pd.read_csv(tsv_path, sep="\t")
+        smiles_col = "smiles.std" if "smiles.std" in df.columns else "smiles"
+        rt_col = "rt" if "rt" in df.columns else "RT"
+        df = df[[smiles_col, rt_col]].dropna()
+        df.columns = ["smiles", "rt"]
+        df["rt"] = pd.to_numeric(df["rt"], errors="coerce")
+        df = df.dropna(subset=["rt"])
+        return df["smiles"].tolist(), df["rt"].values.astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def canonicalize_smiles(smi):
+    """Return canonical SMILES, or None if invalid."""
+    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
+    if mol is None:
+        return None
+    return Chem.MolToSmiles(mol)
+
+
+def canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles_list, rt_array):
+    """
+    Canonicalize all SMILES and deduplicate by canonical SMILES, AVERAGING the retention times
+    of duplicates (uses every replicate measurement and is order-independent, unlike keep-first).
+
+    Compounds are returned in first-seen order, so the deduplicated set and its ordering match
+    keep-first exactly --- only the RT label of a duplicated compound changes (mean, not first).
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    canon_smiles : list[str]   — deduplicated canonical SMILES (first-seen order)
+    rt_array     : np.ndarray  — mean RT per unique compound
+    orig_indices : np.ndarray  — first original index of each unique compound
+    """
+    order = []
+    rts = {}
+    first_idx = {}
+
+    for i, smi in enumerate(smiles_list):
+        csmi = canonicalize_smiles(str(smi))
+        if csmi is None:
+            continue
+        if csmi not in rts:
+            rts[csmi] = []
+            first_idx[csmi] = i
+            order.append(csmi)
+        rts[csmi].append(rt_array[i])
+
+    rt_list = [float(np.mean(rts[c])) for c in order]
+    orig_idx_list = [first_idx[c] for c in order]
+    return order, np.array(rt_list, dtype=np.float32), np.array(orig_idx_list)
+
+
+def determine_thr(rt):
+    """Non-eluting (void) RT threshold. Mirrors ``scripts/preprocess_graph.determine_thr``:
+    walk the unique RTs ascending, tracking the last **repeated** RT (the void plateau, where many
+    compounds co-elute); stop once 3 consecutive **unique** RTs appear (the real separation region).
+    Compounds with ``rt <= thr`` are non-eluting and should be dropped. Returns the threshold (0.0
+    when no early co-elution plateau exists, i.e. a strict no-op for well-separated datasets)."""
+    rt = np.asarray(rt, dtype=np.float64)
+    vals, counts = np.unique(rt, return_counts=True)   # sorted ascending, like value_counts().sort_index()
+    thr, pre_single, c = 0.0, True, 0
+    for v, cnt in zip(vals, counts):
+        if cnt > 1:
+            thr, pre_single, c = float(v), False, 0
+        elif cnt == 1 and pre_single:
+            c += 1
+        else:
+            pre_single, c = True, 1
+        if c > 2:
+            return thr
+    return thr
+
+
+def kfold_split(n_or_smiles, cv_id, n_splits=5, seed=42):
+    """
+    Compound-level k-fold split.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    n_or_smiles : int or list[str]
+        If int, split indices 0..n-1.
+        If list, used only for its length (canonical SMILES already deduped by caller).
+    cv_id       : int  — which fold to use as test (0-indexed)
+    n_splits    : int
+    seed        : int
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    train_idx : np.ndarray
+    test_idx  : np.ndarray
+    """
+    import os
+    # Env override so all baselines can be run at a chosen fold seed without
+    # editing each run.py, e.g. FOLD_SEED=42 to pair with the TSTL runs.
+    seed = int(os.environ.get("FOLD_SEED", seed))
+    n = n_or_smiles if isinstance(n_or_smiles, int) else len(n_or_smiles)
+    if n_splits == 1:
+        # Sanity-check mode: 80/20 split, no CV
+        rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+        perm = rng.permutation(n)
+        split = int(0.8 * n)
+        return perm[:split], perm[split:]
+    kf = KFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
+    splits = list(kf.split(range(n)))
+    train_idx, test_idx = splits[cv_id]
+    return train_idx, test_idx
+
+
+def random_val_split(train_idx, val_ratio=0.1, seed=42):
+    """
+    Split train_idx into train_subset and val_subset.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    train_sub_idx : np.ndarray
+    val_sub_idx   : np.ndarray
+    """
+    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
+    idx = rng.permutation(len(train_idx))
+    val_size = max(1, int(val_ratio * len(train_idx)))
+    val_sub = train_idx[idx[:val_size]]
+    train_sub = train_idx[idx[val_size:]]
+    return train_sub, val_sub
+
+
+def normalize_rt(train_labels):
+    """
+    Returns (mean, std) computed from train_labels.
+    """
+    mean = float(np.mean(train_labels))
+    std = float(np.std(train_labels))
+    if std < 1e-8:
+        std = 1.0
+    return mean, std
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import argparse, os
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--dataset", default="report0184")
+    parser.add_argument("--n_folds", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument("--data_root", default="data/processed_graph")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    npz = os.path.join(args.data_root, f"dataset_graph_{args.dataset}.npz")
+    smiles, rt = load_smiles_and_rt(npz)
+    print(f"Loaded {len(smiles)} molecules from {args.dataset}")
+    canon, rt_dedup, orig_idx = canonicalize_and_dedup(smiles, rt)
+    print(f"After canonicalize+dedup: {len(canon)} unique compounds")
+    train_idx, test_idx = kfold_split(len(canon), cv_id=0, n_splits=args.n_folds)
+    print(f"Fold 0: train={len(train_idx)}, test={len(test_idx)}")
+    train_sub, val_sub = random_val_split(train_idx)
+    print(f"  train_sub={len(train_sub)}, val_sub={len(val_sub)}")
+    mean, std = normalize_rt(rt_dedup[train_idx])
+    print(f"  RT mean={mean:.2f}, std={std:.2f}")

+"""
+Chromatographic parameter encoder for Graphormer-RT.
+
+Two separate pre-graph encoders:
+  - IntEncoder: processes integer / one-hot features (mobile phase additives, column manufacturer, USP code)
+  - FloatEncoder: processes float features (gradient times/%B, column dimensions, pH, temperature, flow rate)
+
+Each projects inputs through two linear layers → 256 → 512 (ReLU + dropout p=0.05).
+The two outputs are summed and stored in the global chromatography node.
+
+Reference: Stienstra et al. Anal. Chem. 2025, 97, 4461–4472.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Additive / manufacturer / USP-code vocabularies (from paper Table 1 / code)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+MOBILE_PHASE_ADDITIVES = [
+    "formic_acid",
+    "acetic_acid",
+    "tfa",       # trifluoroacetic acid
+    "ammonia",
+    "ammonium_acetate",
+    "ammonium_formate",
+    "ammonium_bicarbonate",
+    "tea",       # triethylamine
+    "water",
+    "methanol",
+    "acetonitrile",
+    "isopropanol",
+    "other",
+]
+
+COLUMN_MANUFACTURERS = [
+    "waters",
+    "agilent",
+    "phenomenex",
+    "thermo",
+    "merck",
+    "shimadzu",
+    "sigma_aldrich",
+    "other",
+]
+
+# USP codes relevant to RP-LC and HILIC
+USP_CODES = [
+    "L1",   # C18
+    "L7",   # C8
+    "L11",  # Phenyl
+    "L43",  # C18, specialty
+    "L60",  # HILIC
+    "L66",  # BEH amide HILIC
+    "L114", # ZIC-HILIC
+    "L68",  # HSS T3
+    "L85",  # BEH C18
+    "L10",  # Cyano
+    "other",
+]
+
+# Sizes for one-hot blocks
+N_ADDITIVES = len(MOBILE_PHASE_ADDITIVES)    # per channel A and B → 2×N
+N_MANUFACTURERS = len(COLUMN_MANUFACTURERS)
+N_USP_CODES = len(USP_CODES)
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Feature extraction from metadata row
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _safe_float(val, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
+    try:
+        f = float(val)
+        return f if math.isfinite(f) else default
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return default
+
+
+# RepoRT eluent column suffix (eluent.<A|B>.<suffix>) -> our additive/solvent vocabulary
+_ELUENT_FIELD = {
+    "water": "h2o", "methanol": "meoh", "acetonitrile": "acn", "isopropanol": "iproh",
+    "formic_acid": "formic", "acetic_acid": "acetic", "tfa": "trifluoroacetic",
+    "ammonia": "nh4oh", "ammonium_acetate": "nh4ac", "ammonium_formate": "nh4form",
+    "ammonium_bicarbonate": "nh4bicarb", "tea": "trieth",
+}
+
+
+def _channel_additive_multihot(row: pd.Series, channel: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Multi-hot the solvents/additives present in eluent channel A or B, read from RepoRT's
+    per-component composition fields (eluent.<channel>.<component> > 0)."""
+    vec = np.zeros(N_ADDITIVES, dtype=np.float32)
+    any_set = False
+    for i, name in enumerate(MOBILE_PHASE_ADDITIVES):
+        suffix = _ELUENT_FIELD.get(name)
+        if suffix and _safe_float(row.get(f"eluent.{channel}.{suffix}", 0.0), 0.0) > 0:
+            vec[i] = 1.0
+            any_set = True
+    if not any_set:
+        vec[MOBILE_PHASE_ADDITIVES.index("other")] = 1.0
+    return vec
+
+
+def _manufacturer_onehot(col_name: Optional[str]) -> np.ndarray:
+    vec = np.zeros(N_MANUFACTURERS, dtype=np.float32)
+    if not col_name or pd.isna(col_name):
+        vec[COLUMN_MANUFACTURERS.index("other")] = 1.0
+        return vec
+    s = str(col_name).lower()
+    for i, name in enumerate(COLUMN_MANUFACTURERS):
+        if name.replace("_", " ") in s:
+            vec[i] = 1.0
+            return vec
+    vec[COLUMN_MANUFACTURERS.index("other")] = 1.0
+    return vec
+
+
+def _usp_onehot(usp_code: Optional[str]) -> np.ndarray:
+    vec = np.zeros(N_USP_CODES, dtype=np.float32)
+    if not usp_code or pd.isna(usp_code):
+        vec[USP_CODES.index("other")] = 1.0
+        return vec
+    s = str(usp_code).strip()
+    if s in USP_CODES:
+        vec[USP_CODES.index(s)] = 1.0
+    else:
+        vec[USP_CODES.index("other")] = 1.0
+    return vec
+
+
+def _gradient_points(gradient: Optional[np.ndarray], row: pd.Series) -> List[float]:
+    """start_%B + 3 (t, %B) points describing the gradient shape.
+
+    Primary source is the full profile from {id}_gradient.tsv (gradient=[[t, %B], ...]); the 3 points
+    are %B interpolated at 1/3, 2/3, 1 of the run so the encoding is fixed-length regardless of how
+    many rows the program has. Falls back to the metadata gradient.start.B / gradient.end.B (a linear
+    2-point approximation) when the profile file is absent."""
+    if gradient is not None and len(gradient) >= 2:
+        t, b = gradient[:, 0], gradient[:, 1]
+        t_max = float(t[-1])
+        start_b = float(b[0])
+        pts = [start_b]
+        for frac in (1.0 / 3, 2.0 / 3, 1.0):
+            tq = t_max * frac
+            pts.extend([tq, float(np.interp(tq, t, b))])
+        return pts
+    # fallback: linear start->end over the (unknown) run time from metadata fields
+    start_b = _safe_float(row.get("gradient.start.B", 0.0), 0.0)
+    end_b = _safe_float(row.get("gradient.end.B", start_b), start_b)
+    return [start_b, 0.0, start_b, 0.0, (start_b + end_b) / 2, 0.0, end_b]
+
+
+def _parse_gradient(row: pd.Series, gradient: Optional[np.ndarray] = None) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """
+    Returns (float_feats, int_feats) describing the gradient program.
+
+    Float features (9): start_%B, (t1,%B1), (t2,%B2), (t3,%B3), pH_A, pH_B
+    Int features: additive/solvent multi-hot for channel A (N_ADDITIVES) + channel B (N_ADDITIVES)
+    """
+    float_pts = _gradient_points(gradient, row)                      # length 7
+    ph_a = _safe_float(row.get("eluent.A.pH", 7.0), 7.0)
+    ph_b = _safe_float(row.get("eluent.B.pH", 7.0), 7.0)
+    float_feats = np.array(float_pts + [ph_a, ph_b], dtype=np.float32)  # length 9
+
+    add_a = _channel_additive_multihot(row, "A")
+    add_b = _channel_additive_multihot(row, "B")
+    int_feats = np.concatenate([add_a, add_b])                       # length 2*N_ADDITIVES
+
+    return float_feats.astype(np.float32), int_feats.astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def _parse_column(row: pd.Series) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """
+    Returns (float_feats, int_feats) describing the column (RepoRT dot-schema metadata).
+
+    Float features (6): [length_mm, id_mm, particle_size_um, dead_time_min, temp_K, flow_rate_mL_min]
+    Int/one-hot: manufacturer one-hot (from column.name) + USP code one-hot (column.usp.code)
+    """
+    length = _safe_float(row.get("column.length", 100.0), 100.0)
+    col_id = _safe_float(row.get("column.id", 2.1), 2.1)
+    particle = _safe_float(row.get("column.particle.size", 1.7), 1.7)
+    dead_vol = _safe_float(row.get("column.t0", 0.5), 0.5)
+    temp = _safe_float(row.get("column.temperature", 40.0), 40.0)
+    temp_k = temp + 273.15 if temp < 200 else temp  # convert C→K
+    flow = _safe_float(row.get("column.flowrate", 0.4), 0.4)
+
+    float_feats = np.array([length, col_id, particle, dead_vol, temp_k, flow], dtype=np.float32)
+
+    mfr_oh = _manufacturer_onehot(str(row.get("column.name", "")))
+    usp_oh = _usp_onehot(str(row.get("column.usp.code", "")))
+    int_feats = np.concatenate([mfr_oh, usp_oh])  # length N_MANUFACTURERS + N_USP_CODES
+
+    return float_feats.astype(np.float32), int_feats.astype(np.float32)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Dimensions
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+GRAD_FLOAT_DIM = 9          # start_%B + 3×(t,B) + pH_A + pH_B
+GRAD_INT_DIM = 2 * N_ADDITIVES
+COL_FLOAT_DIM = 6
+COL_INT_DIM = N_MANUFACTURERS + N_USP_CODES
+
+TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM = GRAD_FLOAT_DIM + COL_FLOAT_DIM  # 15
+TOTAL_INT_DIM = GRAD_INT_DIM + COL_INT_DIM         # 2*13 + 8 + 11 = 45
+
+
+def extract_chrom_features(row: pd.Series, gradient: Optional[np.ndarray] = None) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """
+    Extract combined (float_feats, int_feats) from a RepoRT metadata row (+ optional gradient
+    profile array [[t, %B], ...] from load_gradient_profile). Returns arrays of shape
+    (TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM,) and (TOTAL_INT_DIM,). Prefer get_chrom_features(), which loads the gradient.
+    """
+    grad_f, grad_i = _parse_gradient(row, gradient)
+    col_f, col_i = _parse_column(row)
+    return (
+        np.concatenate([grad_f, col_f]).astype(np.float32),
+        np.concatenate([grad_i, col_i]).astype(np.float32),
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Neural network encoders
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+class ChromIntEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Encoder for integer / one-hot chromatography features."""
+
+    def __init__(self, input_dim: int = TOTAL_INT_DIM, hidden: int = 256, out_dim: int = 512):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.net = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden),
+            nn.ReLU(),
+            nn.Dropout(0.05),
+            nn.Linear(hidden, out_dim),
+            nn.ReLU(),
+            nn.Dropout(0.05),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.net(x)
+
+
+class ChromFloatEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Encoder for float chromatography features."""
+
+    def __init__(self, input_dim: int = TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM, hidden: int = 256, out_dim: int = 512):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.net = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden),
+            nn.ReLU(),
+            nn.Dropout(0.05),
+            nn.Linear(hidden, out_dim),
+            nn.ReLU(),
+            nn.Dropout(0.05),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.net(x)
+
+
+class ChromEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """
+    Combined chromatography encoder.
+    Produces a single embedding by summing outputs of IntEncoder and FloatEncoder.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, out_dim: int = 512):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.int_encoder = ChromIntEncoder(TOTAL_INT_DIM, 256, out_dim)
+        self.float_encoder = ChromFloatEncoder(TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM, 256, out_dim)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        int_feats: torch.Tensor,    # (B, TOTAL_INT_DIM)
+        float_feats: torch.Tensor,  # (B, TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM)
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:              # (B, out_dim)
+        return self.int_encoder(int_feats) + self.float_encoder(float_feats)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Metadata loading helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def load_dataset_metadata(dataset_id: str, repo_rt_root: str) -> Optional[pd.Series]:
+    """
+    Load the first metadata row for a given dataset ID from its TSV file.
+    Returns None if not found.
+    """
+    import glob as _glob
+
+    # Try numeric id (e.g. "0263" from "report0263") with both suffixed and flat dirs
+    id_str = dataset_id.replace("report", "").zfill(4)
+    for dir_pattern in (f"{id_str}_*", id_str):
+        pattern = os.path.join(repo_rt_root, dir_pattern, f"{id_str}_metadata.tsv")
+        matches = _glob.glob(pattern)
+        if matches:
+            break
+
+    if not matches:
+        # fall back to full dataset_id patterns
+        for dir_pattern in (f"{dataset_id}_*", f"*{dataset_id}*"):
+            pattern = os.path.join(repo_rt_root, dir_pattern, f"*metadata.tsv")
+            matches = _glob.glob(pattern)
+            if matches:
+                break
+    if not matches:
+        return None
+
+    tsv_path = matches[0]
+    df = pd.read_csv(tsv_path, sep="\t", nrows=1)
+    return df.iloc[0]
+
+
+def load_gradient_profile(dataset_id: str, repo_rt_root: str) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
+    """Load the gradient program from {id}_gradient.tsv as an array [[t_min, %B], ...] (sorted by
+    time). Returns None if the file is absent (extract_chrom_features then uses the metadata fallback)."""
+    import glob as _glob
+
+    id_str = dataset_id.replace("report", "").zfill(4)
+    matches = []
+    for dir_pattern in (id_str, f"{id_str}_*"):
+        matches = _glob.glob(os.path.join(repo_rt_root, dir_pattern, f"{id_str}_gradient.tsv"))
+        if matches:
+            break
+    if not matches:
+        return None
+    df = pd.read_csv(matches[0], sep="\t")
+    t_col = next((c for c in df.columns if c.strip().lower().startswith("t ")), None)
+    b_col = next((c for c in df.columns if c.strip().lower().startswith("b ")), None)
+    if t_col is None or b_col is None or len(df) == 0:
+        return None
+    prof = df[[t_col, b_col]].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").dropna().to_numpy(np.float32)
+    prof = prof[np.argsort(prof[:, 0])]                                  # ensure increasing time
+    return prof if len(prof) else None
+
+
+def get_chrom_features(dataset_id: str, repo_rt_root: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Full chromatography feature vector for a dataset: loads metadata + gradient profile and
+    extracts. Returns zeros if the metadata is missing."""
+    row = load_dataset_metadata(dataset_id, repo_rt_root)
+    if row is None:
+        print(f"[chrom_encoder] WARNING: metadata not found for {dataset_id}, using zeros.")
+        return (np.zeros(TOTAL_FLOAT_DIM, dtype=np.float32), np.zeros(TOTAL_INT_DIM, dtype=np.float32))
+    return extract_chrom_features(row, load_gradient_profile(dataset_id, repo_rt_root))
+
+
+def build_chrom_feature_map(
+    dataset_ids: List[str],
+    repo_rt_root: str,
+) -> Dict[str, Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:
+    """
+    Build a mapping {dataset_id: (float_feats, int_feats)} for each dataset (real RepoRT metadata +
+    gradient profile). Missing datasets fall back to zeros with a warning.
+    """
+    return {did: get_chrom_features(did, repo_rt_root) for did in dataset_ids}

+"""Pure-PyTorch metadata-free GNN backbone for TIMPANI (no DGL / no PyG).
+
+``GNN`` implements the same meta contract as ``Graphormer`` — ``task_context`` (returns
+``None``: metadata-free), ``forward(graphs, z)`` == ``predict``, ``head_param_names``,
+``encoder_param_names`` — so it drops straight into ``TimpTrainer`` (ANIL: inner loop adapts the head
+only; encoder meta-learned in the outer loop). Message passing is done with ``index_add`` /
+``scatter_reduce`` over an ``edge_index``, so the whole method runs anywhere torch runs.
+
+Currently a GIN encoder; MPNN/GAT slot in behind the same ``GNN`` interface. Graphs are the dicts
+from ``timp.models.gnn_features.smiles_to_gnn_graph`` ({node_attr, edge_attr, edge_index, n_node})."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import time
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+_READOUT = {"mean": "mean", "sum": "sum", "max": "amax"}
+
+
+class GINLayer(nn.Module):
+    """h_v <- act(LayerNorm(MLP((1+eps)h_v + sum_{u in N(v)} h_u))).
+    LayerNorm (not BatchNorm): no running stats -> meta/functional-safe, and empirically the
+    best/most stable norm on the small per-task RT datasets."""
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, dropout: float = 0.1):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(dim, dim), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(dim, dim))
+        self.eps = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
+        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
+        self.act = nn.ReLU()
+        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
+
+    def forward(self, h: torch.Tensor, edge_index: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if edge_index.numel() > 0:
+            src, dst = edge_index[0], edge_index[1]
+            agg = torch.zeros_like(h).index_add(0, dst, h[src])
+        else:
+            agg = torch.zeros_like(h)
+        out = self.mlp((1.0 + self.eps) * h + agg)
+        return self.drop(self.act(self.norm(out)))
+
+
+class GINEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, node_in_feats: int, emb_dim: int, num_layers: int, dropout: float):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.project = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(node_in_feats, emb_dim), nn.ReLU())
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([GINLayer(emb_dim, dropout) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+
+    def forward(self, x, edge_index, edge_attr=None):
+        h = self.project(x)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            h = layer(h, edge_index)
+        return h
+
+
+class MPNNLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Edge-conditioned message passing (Gilmer et al.): m_v = sum_{u->v} MLP([h_u, h_v, e_uv]);
+    h_v <- GRUCell(m_v, h_v)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, edge_in: int, dropout: float = 0.1):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.msg = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * dim + edge_in, dim), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(dim, dim))
+        self.gru = nn.GRUCell(dim, dim)
+        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
+        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
+
+    def forward(self, h, edge_index, edge_attr):
+        if edge_index.numel() > 0:
+            src, dst = edge_index[0], edge_index[1]
+            m = self.msg(torch.cat([h[src], h[dst], edge_attr], dim=1))
+            agg = torch.zeros_like(h).index_add(0, dst, m)
+        else:
+            agg = torch.zeros_like(h)
+        return self.drop(self.norm(self.gru(agg, h)))
+
+
+class MPNNEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, node_in_feats, edge_in_feats, emb_dim, num_layers, dropout):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.project = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(node_in_feats, emb_dim), nn.ReLU())
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([MPNNLayer(emb_dim, edge_in_feats, dropout) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+
+    def forward(self, x, edge_index, edge_attr=None):
+        h = self.project(x)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            h = layer(h, edge_index, edge_attr)
+        return h
+
+
+class GATLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Multi-head graph attention (Velickovic et al.) with self-loops; pure-torch segment softmax."""
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, heads: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
+        super().__init__()
+        assert dim % heads == 0, "emb_dim must be divisible by heads"
+        self.heads, self.dk = heads, dim // heads
+        self.W = nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False)
+        self.a_src = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(heads, self.dk))
+        self.a_dst = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(heads, self.dk))
+        nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.a_src); nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.a_dst)
+        self.leaky = nn.LeakyReLU(0.2)
+        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
+        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
+
+    def forward(self, h, edge_index, edge_attr=None):
+        N = h.size(0)
+        Wh = self.W(h).view(N, self.heads, self.dk)
+        loop = torch.arange(N, device=h.device)
+        if edge_index.numel() > 0:
+            src = torch.cat([edge_index[0], loop]); dst = torch.cat([edge_index[1], loop])
+        else:
+            src, dst = loop, loop
+        e = self.leaky((Wh[src] * self.a_src).sum(-1) + (Wh[dst] * self.a_dst).sum(-1))   # (E, H)
+        # stable segment softmax over incoming edges per dst, per head
+        idxH = dst.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, self.heads)
+        mx = h.new_full((N, self.heads), float("-inf")).scatter_reduce(0, idxH, e, reduce="amax", include_self=False)
+        a = (e - mx[dst]).exp()
+        denom = h.new_zeros(N, self.heads).index_add(0, dst, a) + 1e-16
+        alpha = self.drop(a / denom[dst])                                                 # (E, H)
+        out = h.new_zeros(N, self.heads, self.dk).index_add(0, dst, alpha.unsqueeze(-1) * Wh[src])
+        return self.norm(out.reshape(N, self.heads * self.dk))
+
+
+class GATEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, node_in_feats, emb_dim, num_layers, heads, dropout):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.project = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(node_in_feats, emb_dim), nn.ReLU())
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([GATLayer(emb_dim, heads, dropout) for _ in range(num_layers)])
+        self.act = nn.ELU()
+
+    def forward(self, x, edge_index, edge_attr=None):
+        h = self.project(x)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            h = self.act(layer(h, edge_index, edge_attr))
+        return h
+
+
+class GNN(nn.Module):
+    """Metadata-free GNN predictor wired for MAML/ANIL. ``z`` is accepted but ignored."""
+
+    HEAD_PREFIX = "head."
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        node_in_feats: int,
+        edge_in_feats: int = 8,
+        emb_dim: int = 300,
+        num_layers: int = 5,
+        n_mlp_layers: int = 2,
+        dropout: float = 0.1,
+        readout: str = "mean",
+        predictor_hidden: int = 256,
+        heads: int = 4,
+        backbone: str = "gin",
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.emb_dim = emb_dim
+        self.readout_mode = _READOUT[readout]
+        if backbone == "gin":
+            self.encoder = GINEncoder(node_in_feats, emb_dim, num_layers, dropout)
+        elif backbone == "mpnn":
+            self.encoder = MPNNEncoder(node_in_feats, edge_in_feats, emb_dim, num_layers, dropout)
+        elif backbone == "gat":
+            self.encoder = GATEncoder(node_in_feats, emb_dim, num_layers, heads, dropout)
+        else:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"GNN backbone '{backbone}' not implemented")
+        layers, d = [], emb_dim
+        for _ in range(max(1, n_mlp_layers - 1)):
+            layers += [nn.Linear(d, predictor_hidden), nn.ReLU()]
+            d = predictor_hidden
+        layers += [nn.Linear(d, 1)]
+        self.head = nn.Sequential(*layers)
+
+    # --- meta contract ---------------------------------------------------------
+    def task_context(self, chrom_int_row, chrom_float_row):
+        return None  # metadata-free: no condition context
+
+    def _readout(self, h: torch.Tensor, batch: torch.Tensor, n_graphs: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        idx = batch.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, h.size(1))
+        out = h.new_zeros(n_graphs, h.size(1))
+        return out.scatter_reduce(0, idx, h, reduce=self.readout_mode, include_self=False)
+
+    def predict(self, graphs: List[Optional[dict]], z=None, device=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        device = device if device is not None else next(self.parameters()).device
+        xs, eis, eas, batch, slots = [], [], [], [], []
+        node_off, v = 0, 0
+        for bi, g in enumerate(graphs):
+            if g is None:
+                continue
+            n = g["n_node"]
+            xs.append(torch.as_tensor(g["node_attr"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device))
+            if g["edge_index"].shape[1] > 0:
+                eis.append(torch.as_tensor(g["edge_index"], dtype=torch.long, device=device) + node_off)
+                eas.append(torch.as_tensor(g["edge_attr"], dtype=torch.float32, device=device))
+            batch.append(torch.full((n,), v, dtype=torch.long, device=device))
+            slots.append(bi)
+            node_off += n
+            v += 1
+        B = len(graphs)
+        if v == 0:
+            return torch.zeros(B, device=device)
+        x = torch.cat(xs, 0)
+        edge_index = torch.cat(eis, 1) if eis else torch.zeros((2, 0), dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+        edge_attr = torch.cat(eas, 0) if eas else None
+        h = self.encoder(x, edge_index, edge_attr)
+        g_emb = self._readout(h, torch.cat(batch, 0), v)
+        pv = self.head(g_emb).squeeze(-1)
+        return torch.zeros(B, device=device).index_add(0, torch.as_tensor(slots, device=device), pv)
+
+    def forward(self, graphs, z=None, device=None):
+        return self.predict(graphs, z, device=device)
+
+    def head_param_names(self) -> List[str]:
+        return [n for n, _ in self.named_parameters() if n.startswith(self.HEAD_PREFIX)]
+
+    def encoder_param_names(self) -> List[str]:
+        return [n for n, _ in self.named_parameters() if n.startswith("encoder.")]
+
+    def condition_param_names(self) -> List[str]:
+        return []  # metadata-free: no condition pathway
+
+
+# --- Stage-2 fine-tune (pure-torch; mirrors the GRT fit loop) -------------------
+def gnn_finetune(model, train, val, test, device, lr, epochs, patience,
+                 rt_mean, rt_std, freeze_encoder, batch_size=64, grad_clip=1.0, verbose=False):
+    """train/val/test: lists of (graph_dict, normalized_label). Freezes the encoder when
+    ``freeze_encoder`` (ANIL-consistent). Returns (y_true, y_pred, train_sec) in RT units."""
+    if freeze_encoder:
+        for n, p in model.named_parameters():
+            if n.startswith("encoder."):
+                p.requires_grad_(False)
+        n_tr = sum(p.requires_grad for p in model.parameters())
+        if verbose:
+            print(f"[gnn] frozen encoder: {n_tr} tensors trainable")
+    params = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
+    opt = torch.optim.Adam(params, lr=lr)
+    sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(opt, patience=10, factor=0.5, min_lr=1e-7)
+    huber = nn.HuberLoss(delta=1.0)   # Huber (delta=1): robust to RT outliers, matches the paper
+
+    def run(data):
+        model.eval()
+        ys, ps = [], []
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for i in range(0, len(data), batch_size):
+                chunk = data[i:i + batch_size]
+                ps.append(model.predict([d[0] for d in chunk], None, device).cpu())
+                ys.append(torch.tensor([d[1] for d in chunk], dtype=torch.float32))
+        return torch.cat(ys), torch.cat(ps)
+
+    best, best_state, noimp, t0 = float("inf"), None, 0, time.time()
+    for _ep in range(epochs):
+        model.train()
+        perm = torch.randperm(len(train)).tolist()
+        for i in range(0, len(train), batch_size):
+            idx = perm[i:i + batch_size]
+            gs = [train[j][0] for j in idx]
+            yy = torch.tensor([train[j][1] for j in idx], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+            opt.zero_grad()
+            loss = huber(model.predict(gs, None, device), yy)
+            loss.backward()
+            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), grad_clip)
+            opt.step()
+        yv, pv = run(val)
+        vloss = huber(pv, yv).item()
+        sched.step(vloss)
+        if vloss < best:
+            best, best_state, noimp = vloss, copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict()), 0
+        else:
+            noimp += 1
+            if noimp >= patience:
+                break
+    if best_state is not None:
+        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
+    yt, pt = run(test)
+    return (yt.numpy() * rt_std + rt_mean), (pt.numpy() * rt_std + rt_mean), time.time() - t0
